tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa kun dga' dpal bzang po'i

rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gser gyi rnga bo che zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ra we/ dpal ldan bla ma mchog tu grub pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar gser gyi rnga bo che zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa grub pa'i dbang po gang gi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde chen dngos po kuna~X gyi ngo bo nyid/ /lhan skyes dga~X' ba'i ye shes mchog brnyes te/ /dpa~Xl ldana~X skal ba bza~Xng po~X'i gdul bya'i tshogs/ /rdo rje'i sa la 'god mdzad gang khyod rgyal/ /phun tshogs dngos kun ngo bo gdod nas rnyogs bral bde chen rlabs brgya gnyer ba chos nyid mchog gi rgya mtsho dang*/ /zag med yon tan cha shas rab bkang 'od gsal chu mthong rjes 'gro rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes 'od brgya'i mdzod/ /bcu gnyis 'pho ba dag pas bden don 'od zer 'bar ba chos la rdzogs par longs spyod nyin mor byed pa'i sku/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i rtse mor son pas de nyid mngon rig sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rang bzhin dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /gang yang 'jig rten sgron me rnams/ / mun pa'i bskal pa gzhom pa'i phyir/ /mos par ldan pa'i gzhan dbang bzhin/ /dus dang dus su 'jug pa nyid/ /de slad gru 'dzin bdag po'i thugs rje'i zer/ /bod yul kuna~X da'i dga~X' tshal 'dir shar ba/ /dpa~Xl ldana~X skal ba bza~Xng po~X'i 'dab ma dag /ches cher rgyas pa'i dus ston lhag par 'phel/ / kuna~X la byams dang brtse bas skyong ba la/ /dga~X' ldan bdag po de dang dbyer med cing*/ /dpa~Xl 'byor srid zhi'i phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos/ /bza~Xng po~X'i 'gro kun skyong ba'i mdzad pa nas/ /dam pa'i mdzad pa pha mtha' med pa'i mkha'/ /bdag blo'i bung pas gzhal bar mi nus mod/ /'on kyang rang nyid mos dang skal mnyam la'ang*/ /phan phyir mdo tsam dgod la skyon yod min/ / rnam thar ngo mtshar gser gyi rnga bo che/ /bskul mkhas dbyug gu'i byed pa mang ston pas/

/drang po'i dbyangs kyis 'brug sgra 'bum gyi shugs/ /'gog nus 'di la thar 'dod rna ba bye/ /'dir bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje'i khyad par gangs can ljongs 'dir ngur smrig 'dzin par bstan pa/ don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te rje btsun dam pa kun dga' dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa thun mong du grags pa cung zad bkod na/ rje btsun 'di'i rigs rus cho 'brang ni/ rgyal thang du lha rgyal thang dkar po las mched de/ gnyag ston shākya mu ne la sogs pa mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dpal 'dzin pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi lugs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dpa' ba dang rtul phod pa dang*/ blo gros che ba dang*/ gzhung bzang ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan par rim par byon pa zhal ngo gcig gis glo bo'i phyogs yul dge bcu tshang zhing bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan du ma dang ldan pa'i yul ljongs su phebs/ de'i tshe sa chen skyong ba dge sbyong a ma dpal zla ba gsar du tshes pa dang dpon blon du gyur/ sger du'ang yangs pa'i sa chen po la dbang mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po gdan drangs/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ thub chen rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzug pa sogs kyi bdag gnyer ma lus pa mdzad/ de'i sras dbon drung tshe dbang bzang po zhes bya ba des/ tshangs pa chen po bkra shis mgon sku mched kyi bka'i blon po mdzad/ lugs gnyis kyi bya ba la mkhas pas dpon blon gnyis ka'i phywa srid yar ngo zla ba ltar 'phel dgra bo'i sde mi bsrun pa mtha' dag tshar bcad/ rang srid rnams byams pa chen pos bskyangs/ thub dbang gnyis pa paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan slob ma'i tshogs rgya mtsho lta bus bskor ba sa'i phyogs der dpon blon gyis gdan drangs/ lo gsum du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bdag rkyen mdzad pa sogs lugs gnyis kyi bya ba bsam gyis mi khyab/

sprul pa'i gang zag tu grags/ de nyid kyi gcung po ni dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' mchog grub yin/ dpon drung tshe dbang bzang po des btsun mo gnyis khab tu bzhes pa'i snga ma'i sras dbon drung tshe dar skyabs pa sku mched rnams yin zha ི nga*/ phyi ma'i sras ni dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i ye shes kyi snang brnyan rje btsun dam pa 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog yin no/ /dpon drung tshe dar skyabs pa de nyid lugs gnyis kyi mkhyen pa che bas mnga' ris nyid du zhal ngo snga ma rnams las kyang ches lhag pa tsam mdzad cing*/ dbus gtsang gi ljongs su byon/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya mchog ldan la zab chos du ma gsan/ gser mdog can gyi gtsos pa'i dbus gtsang gi chos sde dang chos 'khor lha sa la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang khyad par can phal cher mjal zhing*/ de thams cad du mang ja 'gyed bcas/ mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ byang ngam ring*/ rgya mkhar rtse gzhis ka rin spungs sogs su rgyang sa re bzhugs shing*/ khyad par gzhis kar zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal shin tu dgyes/ de dag tu sgyu rtsal thams cad la byang zhing blo gros che ba blon po shing gi lag pa can zhes gtsug lag gnyis la phul du phyin pa'i grags pa can de/ rje nyid kyi yab yin la/ yum dpon mo dpal khrid ces bya ba mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags dang ldan pa de yin/ de gnyis kyi sras su mnga' ris smad kyi sa'i cha/ smon thang rgyal po'i khab dang nye ba'i nub byang mtshams/ bsam 'grub rab brtan zhes bya ba/ rnam thos sras kyi pho brang lta bu der/ dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya'i lor hor lugs kyi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu gza' skar dus sbyor bzang po la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas sku bltams/ de nub dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' mchog grub kyi mnal lam du/ thub pa'i gser sku dri mas cung zad gos pa zhig la khrus chab phul ba'i mtshan ma byung*/

de'i sar khrus zhu mkhan byung bas/ de la byis pa 'di bstan pa la phan thogs mkhan gcig 'ong gis gtsang sbra legs par gyis gsungs so/ /rjai de dang byang sems shes rab dpal 'byor gnyis kyis/ rje 'di nyid yum gyi lhums su zhugs nas bsrung 'khor/ bltams nas sgrol dkar/ rnam 'joms/ sme brtsegs sogs kyi khrus chog dang rjes gnang*/ tshe dbang*/ mgon po'i bka' bsgo sogs yang yang gnang ngo*/ /mtho ris chu 'dzin 'thug po'i 'phreng ba las/ /nye bar 'ongs pa'i rigs rgyud chu bo'i rgyun/ /gnyag ston shākya la sogs dbu ba yi/ /'dzum dkar rgod pa zhing 'di'i dpal du dngar/ /mnga' ris 'dzin ma'i lte bar legs byas kyi/ /myu gu smin pa gur gum gzhon nu'i 'phreng*/ /bsngags 'os dri bzang 'bar ba glo bo yi/ /mi dbang rim pas spyi bo'i rgyan du mdzes/ /de yi lugs bzang rin chen 'byung gnas che/ /rgyas byed gtsug lag bdud rtsi'i 'od 'bar ba/ /bka' yi blon po phur bu'i blo gros can/ /rabs dang rabs su rim par 'byung bar gyur/ /de las sgyu rtsal srid sgrub zil gnon zha ི nga*/ /tshe dar skyabs pa shing lag can zhes grags/ /de yi btsun mo bde sogs skye mched can/ /lus med rtse dga'i 'khri shing dar pa'i dpyid/ /lang tsho'i me tog mchog tu 'dzum pa yi/ /mdzes sdug snying po dpal khrid ces pa byung*/ /dge ba'i las kyi srad bu la rgyus pa'i/ /bsngags par 'os pa rin chen cod paṇa 'phreng*/ / mtha' dag skye bo'i mgo la 'god mkhas pa/ /'dod dgu'i phun tshogs ci yang dar bar gyur/ /a di ti las nam mkha'i nor bu dang*/ /rin chen 'byung gnas che las zla ba bzhin/ /thabs dang shes rab 'dus pa'i ngo mtshar las/ /zung 'jug mtshan dpe 'bar ba gang khyod bltams/ /de nas dgung lo bdun tsam bzhes kyi bar khab tu bzhugs te yab yum gyis byams pas bskyangs/ dgung lo bdun gyi steng du dpal brtse ba chen po kun dga' mchog grub kyi drung du/

dge bsnyen sngon du 'gro bas dbu'i gtsug phud phul/ ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bzhes te bar ma rab tu byung ba dang*/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa nod de mtshan kun dga' dpal bzang du 'dogs par mdzad/ las pa chos skyong dpal mchog gis klog yig chos spyod sogs nyer mkho'i bslab sbyangs phul/ rje kun dga' mchog grub las gong smos kyi dbang bka' rjes gnang yang yang dang*/ gzhan yang dze tā ri'i lugs kyi tshe dbang lha dgu sogs bka' chos sogs mang du gsan zhing mnyam med chos kyi rgyal po las/ sgrol dkar rjes gnang khrid bcas/ tshe dbang lha dgu dbang mang po dang*/ mnyam med nyid kyi bka' 'bum gyi lung la sogs pa dang*/ mkhas pa'i rje dpal ldan tshul khrims las phag dkar shes rab gsal byed/ 'jam dbyangs dmar ser sogs kyi rje gnang*/ byang sems shes rab dpal 'byor las tshe dbang*/ rgyal thang lugs kyi gcod 'khrid/ rje btsun mi la dang*/ grub thob gtsang smyon gyi rnam thar lung sogs gsan/ de nas dgung lo bcu dgu pa'i steng du/ 'gran zla dang bral ba'i chos grwa chen po thub bstan gser mdog can du thugs gnyer la phebs bar chas te/ nyid kyi sku mched chos rje kun dga' blo mchog dang gnyis phyag g.yog tu slob gnyer ba sha stag gtos che ba dang bcas ston kha myur bar shangs su phebs/ dus de'i tshe paṇa chen chos kyi rgyal po'i khri thog la mkhas mchog blo gros bzang po dang*/ shangs pa grwa khang du slob dpon mkhas mchog gtsug gi nor bu bzhugs pa dang mjal/ mang ja dang mkhan slob so sor phyag mjal phul/ de mtshams gtsang du 'brum pa byung ba nas 'brum mdzem dang*/ chos zhu sbrags te dbus su phebs/ chos 'khor lha sa gtso bor gyur pa'i gnas/ rten khyad par can rnams mjal der tre bo chos rgyal la tshe dbang dang phag mo lnga khrid gsan/ zhogs rtse dmar du lo de'i lha babs dus chen la rje dbus smyon pa gshegs pa'i gdung mjal gnang*/

zhun thig mang du gsol/ lcang lung chos sdings su phebs nas rje gzhon nu chos grub la mjal kha zhus pas/ mdang dung dkar gnyis kha sprod byas 'bud pa rmis shin du bzang gsungs/ dgyes bzhin du sku mched tsha rong nam mkha' blo gsal dang gsum kas tshal der paṇa chen rin po cher brgyud pa'i gsungs ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa sogs lam skor zhal byung ma lus pa sogs dbang khrid lung mtha' yas pa gsan/ khyad par mnal lam du dar tshon gyi phung po'i nang na rus pa'i mdud pa ma zhig pa'i keng rus kyi gzugs can 'jigs su rung ba zhig gzigs pas/ sang gsol ba ma btab par dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang stsal/ mgon po gur lcam dral lha brgyad/ zhal bzhi pa bsnyen sgrub so so'i rjes gnang*/ de dag dang 'brel ba'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag mtha' yas par gsan/ chos 'khor rtser paṇa chen rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi drung du gsungs ngag rin po che cha tshang*/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid jo nang lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhan ma bu lugs/ dpal ldan bla ma'i lugs/ sha wa ras dmar ston rin chen shākya la gnang ba dang*/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi lugs sogs kyi khrid dang*/ rgya bod kyi lugs srol tha dad pa mang po sogs rgyas par gsan zhing*/ mun khang dang nyin mo'i rnal 'byor sogs la brten rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa gnang bas rtags snang 'byams klas pa mngon du gyur/ paṇa chen gyi gsungs nas sbyor drug gi sgo nas khyed la 'gro don chen po 'ong gsungs pa'i lung bstan pa'ang thob/ gzhan yang zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan nas/ slar gser mdog can du phebs/ mkhan chen las tshe dbang dang*/ spyi chos thob pa gsan zhing*/ slob dpon mkhas mchog gtsug gi nor bu'i drung las/ thog mar phar phyin gyi gzhung chos rgyas par gsan/ de nas rim par 'dul ba/ mngon pa mdzod/ sdom gsum rab dbye rnams la gsan mthil phyin pa gnang*/

slar yang dbus su phebs nas/ sngags chos kyi 'phro rnams dang*/ bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba mdzad de/ lcang lung pa gzhon nu chos grub kyis mkhan po/ paṇa chen rdo rje rgyal bas las slob/ lcang lung pa gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis gsang ston/ rigs gter slob dpon chos rje bsam gtan pas dus bsgo ba mdzad nas/ dge 'dun grangs tshang pa las bsnyen par rdzogs te shin du btsun pa'i mchog tu bzhugs/ phyir phebs skabs lcang lung rin po che nyid kyi zhal gzigs kyi dpal mgon gyi bris sku byin rlabs can sogs kyis gnang sbyin dang*/ thugs brtse ba'i bslab bya lung bstan mang du gnang*/ paṇa chen rdo rje rab rgyal bas kyang chos 'phro dang*/ gnang sbyin bslab ston rgyas par bstsal/ de skabs 'phan yul du karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang mjal/ ma ṇi'i lung bka' 'gra ེ la du gsan no/ /de nas gser mdog can du phebs/ mnga' ris nas spyan 'dren nan can byung nas/ mkhan slob so so'i rdzongs chos gnang sbyin bslab bya dpag med gnang nas mnga' ris la phebs/ phun tshogs bsam gtan gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyis phebs bsu dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs mang pos bsus/ thog mar rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal/ byin gyis brlabs thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ de nas rgya hor dpal bzang dang mjal zhing*/ bla ma slob dpon so so/ sde pa dpon blon/ sku nye rnams dang bcas pas gzhi len rgyas pa byung*/ khyi lo de'i dgun la rje kun dga' mchog grub zhing brjes nas lo skor gcig song ba'i dus chen dang*/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i yum gyi lo mchod sbrags par sgrub mchod rgya cher gnang ba'i skabs/ de nyid sku mched kyis sman bla'i mdo mchod kyi gtso bo gnang / sgrub mchod grol 'phral phun tshogs bsam gtan gling gi gser khang du rje sku mched gnyis kas kyai rdo rje'i gzhi'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa bar chad med par grub rjes/

tshe dpag med kun rig sogs kyi ljags bsnyen mdzad/ de rnams mthar phyin nas sos kar/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du gsungs ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa cha lag yongs rdzogs/ brtag gnyis bshad pa/ bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gshed dmar/ 'jigs byed rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi dbang byin rlabs khrid lung sogs mtha' yas pa dang*/ shangs chos yongs rdzogs/ gzhan yang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ mgon po che chung gi skor/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang sgrub skor sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ spyir bla ma so so las bka' chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan mod/ 'dir bri bar ma nus/ rgyas par gsan yig sogs su shes par bya'o/ /de nas rje de nyid dgung lo nyer dgur phebs pa 'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo phun tshogs bsam gtan gling gi gdan sa la rje de nyid sku mched/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pas bkod pa gnang*/ paṇa chen rin po che chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan la gnang*/ des rjes kun dga' mchog grub dang*/ des rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa la gnang ba'i ston pa'i sku/ rgya dril zlam skyor chen gsum gyis gtsos pa'i gnang sbyin stobs che ba dang bcas shis brjod me tog bcas bstsal/ de mthun sde pa dpon slob sogs thams cad kyis khri ston 'bul ba rgyas par byas/ de nas rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa dbus gtsang la phebs skyel la/ bkra dum gyi bar du sku mched gnyis kas phebs/ der sku mched gnyis dang rje blo gros dbang phyugatsha rong nam mkha' blo gsal sogs glo bo byang dgon dang bcas pa'i che dgu thams cad kyis yar gang myur phebs dgos pas rgyu mtshan nan skyed phul zhing*/ bka' las/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyis dad ldan rnams la ma yin te/ /lar rang yul phyogs lhung can gyi tsher nag 'dir/ /blo gtad su la bkal yang thub pa med/ /mkhas mchog ngang pa'i rgyal po grol mchog dang*/

/nyi ma dbus gtsang dag pa'i pad mtsho rnyog /gsungs pa sogs nas yar phebs pa'i zhal bzhes ma gnang*/ phyis khyed rang skal ldan rnams dang 'phrad pa 'ongs gsungs pa byung*/ phyis skya skyar dad ldan rnams dang mjal ba la gsungs par nges gsungs/ de nas tshur phebs nas dgon pa'i dus chos dang skyong dar sngar srol bzang po gang yod ltar mdzad cing*/ mi dbang khri thog pa'i bkas bskul te/ ri shing sdom gsum gling gi zhal bdag kyang gnang nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang*/ der chos sde'i las slob kyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun spyi dgos su thugs 'dod dang bstun pa'i chos kyis tshims par gnang*/ blon rigs dpon rigs la sogs kun gyis kyang mos dad chen pos rang rang gi 'dod chos zhu ba'i 'phrin las yar rgyas kyi ngang nas sde pa'i bka' bkod kyi sa sde pa o nga'i drung thub bstan gser mdog can du/ thugs gnyer la phebs pa'i dbu 'don dang*/ gdan sa chen pos gtsos pa'i grwa dgon tha dad du bsnyen bkur/ /slob gnyer ba gtos che ba dang bcas myur shar phebs te/ ngam ring du chos rgyal nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje dang mjal nas sman sdings su lo chen rat+na bha dra dang mjal/ bka' 'grel gsan/ rim pas gser mdog can du phebs/ mkhan chen chos rje 'jam dbyangs dpal bzhugs pa dang*/ shangs pa grwa khang du rje 'bum phrag gsum pa dge 'dun nyi ma bzhugs pa mjal/ mang ja 'gyed bcas sogs rgya cher mdzad/ mkhan slob thams cad thugs shin du dgyes par gyur/ o nga'i drung mkhan chen gyi drung du rab byung mdzad pa'i rab ston legs par grub nas/ dpon slob thams cad thugs gnyer la bkod nas/ 'brum bu 'joms pas o nga'i drung chu dbar chos rdzong su phebs/ rgyang tsam song nas rje 'dis rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa dbus nas phebs pa'i phebs bsur lhi khung du phebs/ der mjal nas bka' bkod la nged rnam pa rnams brgyud nas khri khang du 'gro bas khyed rang dpon slob yang der shog gsungs pa bzhin/

gser mdog can du phebs nas sku chas gang yod mang ja grwa ja sogs su btang*/ bsam 'grub rtse brgyud khri khang du phebs pa'i nub man sku 'brum bsnyung nas/ khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams pa'i dgon gnas der spo ba gnang nas legs par nges/ de nas dpon slob tshang ma khri khang du phebs/ rje 'dir sde ba ma chin drung du/ kin+dha ra'i sgra las drangs pa'i grub thob brgyad cu'i bstod pa'i gī ta yang bslab sbyangs phul/ slar bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ brag dmar chos sder mkhan chen gtsug gi nor bu mjal/ de nas snar thang la gnang*/ stag la brgyud nas phebs pas bzhugs sa zhag gcig brag gzhug tu gnang*/ der bzhugs mtsher gyi steng du rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa zhabs 'chag gnang ba'i phyag phyi gnang bas/ rje btsun rin po che'i phyag na dung chung zhig bsnams yod pa 'phang ba gnang song bas spa'u mkhregs pa zhig la 'phog 'dam la brgyab pa bzhin song*/ de rdo zhig la 'phog na yang de bzhin 'gro rgyu yin 'dug gsungs/ de nas 'jed brgyud rin chen gling du phebs/ der zla phyed tsam bzhugs nas yul spe'ur phebs te/ der rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pas/ rje 'di gtso bor gyur pa'i dge chu dang lo phu'i gdan sa ba sogs la rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang*/ de nas brtag gnyis lung rkyang dang*/ de rjes rdo rje gur dang saṃ pu ṭa las bla ma gong ma'i sa bcad tho yigagur la gur brgyan/ saṃ pu ṭa la gnad kyi gsal byed de/ rje btsun sku mched kyi yig steng nas gzab bshad gnang ba gsan/ ngam ring rtser phebs nas bde mchog nag po'i yab bka' yum bka' gsan/ de nas rje btsun rin po che gdan sa chen po brgyud kha'ur phebs nas las chen ye shes lhun grub gdan drangs te sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung gsan pa gnang*/ rje de nyid kyi gdan sa chen por mang ja 'gyed bcas zhus nas/ 'jam dbyangs gzi 'od 'bar ba dang*/

sgo rum gyi bse 'bag sogs kyis gtsos/ sgo rum bzhi thog bla brang shar/ lha khang chen mo sogs gdan sa chen po'i gnas brten khyad par can thams cad mjal/ gus pa chen pos phyag mchod smon lam gnang*/ de nas kha'ur rje btsun rin po ches shangs chos sogs gnang ba mtha' dag gsan/ der kha'u ri brag sgor rab brjid brdo yi khyim/ yongs su grub tshe sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bar chad las yongs su rgyal ba'i grub rtags gnang dus/ rje nyid sku gzhogs rang du yod/ nyes skyon spu tsam ma byung*/ de nas gting skyes su phebs nas sa skya dka' 'bum gyi ljags lung gnang pas/ de lo sa paṇa gyi bka' 'bum yan gsan/ de nas rje btsun rin po che ngam ring du phebs/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sku bzhengs pa'i bsrung 'khor phyag nas sogs gnang*/ de nas dbus sogs la phebs pa'i phyag phyir sgo mar phebs te/ de yang mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rab gnas grub rjes snar thang*/ tshong 'dus/ 'brong rtse sogs nas rim gyis rgya cher phebs/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnam rgyal mjal/ chos 'brel gsan/ mkha' ro brgyud nas rgyal chen gling du phebs/ der rdo rje phur pa'i stod las smad las kyi dbang sogs gsan/ byams pa gling du phebs mchod rten chen mo'i rtser bde mchog gser sku'i rab gnas gnang ba'i gsungs chog phyag phyi gnang nas/ brag dkar dang lcags lung brgyud/ lhun grub rdzong du mus pa dkon mchog grags pa spyan drangs nas rje btsun rin po ches dus 'khor gyi dbang gsan

zhing*/ rje 'dis chos 'brel tsam gsan te stag lung du phebs/ zla ba gcig tsam nas rje btsun rin po che yar rgyab tu phebs/ rje 'dis stag lung ring du bzhugs nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rnam rgyal bkra shis las stag lung bka' brgyud kyi chos skor phal che ba gsan zhing rje btsun rin po che'i thugs dam thang sku rngog dkyil bdun dkyil thang bzheng pa'i zhal bkod gnang*/ zla ba gnyis tsam nas rje btsun rin po che stag lung du phebs/ rje btsun rin po ches mkhan po/ stag lung rin po che las slob/ rje 'dis gsang ston gnang nas dge slong nyis brgyar nye ba bsgrub pa gnang zhing*/ phebs kar stag lung rin po che sku mched thams cad kyis gnang sbyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang*/ nyan po dang nam mkha' khyung rdzong sogs brgyud nas lha sar phebs/ jo mjal rgyas par mdzad/ yar lam nub chos lung dang*/ dngul chu sogs su phebs nas rten mjal gnang nas ngam ring du phebs so/ /de ltar lo gnyis lhag tsam rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs phyir bzhugs te/ de bar du gsungs pa'i zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos bka' bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan zhing*/ der bslab bya dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin mang po gnang*/ mnga' ris nas spyan 'dren pa dang bstun rje btsun rin po ches kyang ljongs ltar gnang nas glo bor phebs/ rje nyid dgung lo sum cu so lnga bzhes pa/ spre'u zhes pa me mo lug gi lo zla tshes gza' skar dge ba la/ chos sde chen po thub bstan dar rgyas gling gi mkhan por mnga' gsol nas/ sde srid khri ston zab rgyas dang*/ dgon chen bdun/ dgon chung bcu so so'i bla ma slob dpon/ chos sde las slob/ blon chen go gsum/ blon phran/ dpon skya sogs kun gyi khri ston rgyas pa phul/ glo bo phyi nang gi che dgu kun gyi mchod yul du gyur nas/ chos sde chen por spyi chos su theg pa chen po dbu ma pa dang sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed thub pa dgongs gsal/

sdom rigs gnyis/ byams chos sde lnga/ sa skya gong ma lnga'i rnam thar gyi ljags lung dgos chos so so'i 'dod pa dang mthun par blo sbyong dpal ye ma'i khrid legs bshad kun 'dus/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum/ bka' gdams glegs bam sogs dang*/ gsang sngags don gnyer las kyai rdo rje mtsho skyes lugs/ man ngag lugs/ ḍoṃ bhi lugs/ nag po lugs te bka' babs bzhi'i dbang*/ yum bka' gzhan dang kun rigami 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med sogs kyi dbang dang rjes gnang mang po/ khrom chos su tshe dbang ma ṇi'i bzlas lung*/ sha wa ri'i rjes gnang sogs yang yang gnang ste 'gro don 'phel bar gyur to/ /mchog gi dge legs sa bon nor 'dzin ma'i/ /lte bar yongs smin rgyas pa'i sa lak+ṣa/ /yon tan snye ma g.yur za ldem pa 'di/ /yid bzhin rin chen mchog gi nor bu bzhin/ /lang tsho 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'char ka nas/ /srid pa'i bde ba pad tshal rgyags 'dzum mar/ /chags bral thun mtshams ngur smrig nyer bzung nas/ /smra ba'i nyi ma gzhon nu lhag par mdzes/ /de ni smon lam rnam dag dri bzhon gyis/ /nyer drungs dbus gtsang dag pa'i mkhar 'phags te/ / lung rigs 'od zer 'bum phrag rab 'phro zhing*/ /mtha' yas sems can kun gyi nyer 'tshor gyur/ /phun tshogs lnga phrag gis brgyan mkhan po yi/ /nyin mor byed las yongs rdzogs sdom pa'i 'od/ /gang sku 'dab brgya rgyas par 'phos pa las/ /mtha' yas yon tan dri bzang gang bar gyur/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi bka' srol chu bo'i rgyun/ /gang thugs rgya mtsho chen por 'babs pa las/ /dngos grub rin po che rnams kun gyi mdzod/ /dbang lung gdams pa'i rlabs phreng phyogs bcur spros/ /de nas thub chen rnam par rgyal ba yis/ /chos kyi sde chen rdo rje gdan gnyis pa'i/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri la mnga' gsol te/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor yongs su gang*/ /sku gsung thugs la nyes pa'i dri tsam gyis/

/yul dus gnas skabs kun tu'ang reg min te/ /mig stong ldan dang rna ba brgya pas kyang*/ /mthong dang thos pa'i yul du gyur pa min/ /bum pa'i mchu sgros gsal ba'i 'dzum ngoms nas/ /tshems phreng kun da'i 'od zer dang lhan cig /dam chos snang ba spros tshe skal bzang la/ /rdzogs ldan dpyid kyi dga' ston gsar du shar/ /de ltar bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya che ba'i ngang nas gtso bor chos sde chen por bzhugs nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing skabs mtshams su/ dol phyogs dang 'brog phyogs rnams su'ang phebs nas sems can mang pa ོ 'i don mdzad/ skabs 'gar sgrub gnas chen po brag steng rdo rje'i brag rdzong la sogs par zab don la mnyam par 'ja ོ ga par mdzad pa'i sgo nas lo bcu tsam song ba na/ bdud kyis byin gyis rlabs pa 'ga' zhig gis byed spyod la brten/ glo bur dus zing rgya chen lang grabs byung bas/ gtso bor sde bdag dpon blon kun zhal 'cham pa deng rang gi gzir bun 'di zhi bar byed pa la rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa dang*/ ngor pa mkhan chen spyan 'dren dgos 'dug cing*/ de la gzhan mas spyan 'dren la phebs dgos zhu ba nan can byung zhing*/ rje nyid rang yang rje btsun rin po che mjal bar phebs spro ba sogs nas phebs te/ jo nang du rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa lcags pho spre'u lo dgun khrid tshugs mtshams su phebs/ glo bo sde srid kyi zhu yig 'bul chas sogs dang zhu dag rnams dang*/ bla ma dam pa nyid kyi gser zangs/ byu ru spos shel/ khyad ras sogs mang du 'bul ba mdzad/ khyad par rje nyid kyi sku rgyan mang dag phul ba rnams la brten/ jo nang chos grwa'i bal po shing kun gyi bkod pa'i mchod rten khyad par du 'phags pa 'di bzhengs pa gnang song*/ zhu don rnams la yang*/ mi rgas nas yul gyi dpe yin pas phebs gsungs ba byung*/ de nas gser mdog can der dus khrid gtso bor gyur pa'i bka' chos gsan/

grol mtshams gzhis ka rin spungs rgyal rtse gtso bor gyur pa'i rje btsun rin po che spyan 'dren 'dug pa la myur skor gnang nas mnga' ris la phebs rtsis dang*/ de bar la rje 'di la ngor du rgyu mtshan rnams phul la bya lo lo thog tu 'dug pas/ nged mnga' ris la 'gro/ 'gro ba'i bar span nor bu gling du mtshams gyis gsungs pa ltar/ khri khang bar phyag phyi gnang nas ngor du phebs rjes sangs rgyas seng ge dang mjal/ chos 'brel gsan/ mang ja zhus nas phebs don rnams zhus pas/ rje btsun rin po che phebs na nged kyang 'gro thub pa byed gsungs pa byung*/ de nas gser mdog can du rten mjal gnang zhing mang ja zhus nas nor bu gling du re zhig sku mtshams dam pa'i khongs nas yang dag 'jog kho na gnang ngo*/ /de nas rje btsun yar phebs pa'i khri khang nas phyag phyi gnang*/ ngam ring du phebs nas spyir yang bka' chos mang ba dang*/ khyad par rje nyid la sger chos su gsung ngag lam 'bras shin tu smin pa/ mgon po'i man ngag yongs rdzogs/ sngar gyi sa skya bka' 'bum gyi 'phro 'phags pa'i bka' 'bum gyi lung rnams gnang zhing*/ der mnga' ris la phebs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan nan skyed 'bul ba gnang nas/ sde pa gzhis byang rgyang gsum po 'di da lta nged kyi kha ta dang*/ chos dbang dam tshig la bsam na sde gzar med par dus bde ba yin/ nged stod phyogs la song na sde gzar yongs zer/ khong gsum ga zhal 'cham 'dug pas phebs ma thub cing*/ spyir yang nged dbus gtsang du bsdad pa bstan pa dang sems can la phan stobs che gsung ba byung nas spyan ma 'drongs/ snga sor nor bu gling du bzhugs skabs rje nyid kyi mnal lam du 'khar rnga zhig brdung ba mdzad kyi 'dug pa la skad med pa zhig byung ba yang*/ rje btsun rin po che spyan mi 'drongs pa'i ltas su dgongs/ der rje btsun rin po che spyan ma 'drongs phyin bdag kyang mi 'gro ba bsdad chog pa dgos zhus pas/

da lan nged 'gro ma thub pa'i khar khyed kyang ma phyin na ci la 'ongs/ cis kyang song phyis 'dir byon dgos pa yong bas de skabs the tshom med par shog gsungs tshe dbang*/ mgon po gur zhal sogs kyi rjes gnang sogs dang*/ dngos po'i gnang sbyin rgya che ba dang bcas rdzongs dar gnang*/ der zhabs la gtugs smon lam rgya cher btab/ 'di phyi'i don 'brel mang po yang snyan lam du phul/ thugs shin tu skyo bzhin pas mnga' ris su phebs te 'di mjal ba'i rjes ma yin no/ /skya skyar byang ri chos rje rgyal mtshan ye shes kyi zhabs tog zhus/ bka' chos thor pa gnang nas glo bor phebs che dgu kun gyis bsu ba'i rim pa gzabs mas bsus te chos sde chen por phebs/ 'tshogs chen la mang ja 'gyed bcas/ thub chen rje blo glos rgyal mtshan gyi gdung 'bum/ dpal brtse ba chen po'i gser gdung sogs rten so so snyan dar/ dkar me/ mchod rdzas/ gtsug lag khang du dar 'phan 'bul ba gnang*/ chos sde 'dzin skyong snga ma kho na ltar gnang mus nas/ phun tshogs bsam gtan gling gi gtsug lag khang ka chen bcu gnyis yod pa gsar 'debs gnang*/ logs bris la gtso bo thub dbang gnas bcu/ g.yas su paṇa chen rin po che/ brtse ba chen po kun dga' mchog grub/ g.yon du rje btsun rin po che/ rje blo mchog rnams kyi zhing khams te/ byings la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ tshe dpag med/ o rgyan rin po che/ gur lha brgyad/ rnam sras rta bdag brgyad rnams kyi zhing khams sbyin bdag dang bcas pa/ de'i bar rnams la sangs rgyas stong sku legs par bzhengs/ rab gnas dga' ston grub mtshams byang spang ler spyan 'dren byung*/ dgon pa'i zhal bdag mdzad nas gtsug lag khang ka ba bcu gnyis ma shing cha glo bo nas drangs nas bzhengs/ ri mo 'phan spyi spun lngas sbyin bdag byas/ legs par grub nas rab tu gnas pa gnang pas me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang*/

brtan bzhugs skabs gtso bo thub dbang gi thugs kar me tog nas gsum chags pa yun ring por gnas pa byung zhing*/ 'phan spyi ba so sos 'bul ba yang rgya cher bar phul/ der tshogs pa la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ lha dgu ngor lugs dang bo dong lugs kyi kun rig gi dbang so sor mi 'khrugs pa/ kyai rdo rje yab bka'/ yum bka' bo dong thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs dam lha lnga'i rjes gnang de'i rnam thar dang*/ paṇa chen rin po che'i rnam thar zhib mo rnam 'byed kyi lung sogs gnang*/ bla brang du mi 'khrugs pa'i ljags bsnyen btang dus/ sdig sgrib dag pa yin dge sbyor gsal snang che ba byung gsungs/ sbyin bdag so so yang 'dod chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ dbu legs mkhan po chos legs bzang pos spyan 'dren zhus/ chos dgon gsum gyi mkhan pos ser sbrengs rgyas par phul/ gang la gang 'dod kyi chos rgya cher bstsal nas glo bor phebs/ rje 'dis bka' phebs nas/ sa skyong bsod nams rgyal po rab rgyal rtse nas gdan drangs/ smon thang gi rgyal srid la mnga' gsol shis brjod khri ston rgyas pa dang bcas pa phul/ glo bo phyi nang kun dus bde 'jam la bkod/ brag stengs su re zhig dben pa bsten pa gnang nas sgrol dkar sogs kyi tshe sgrub 'ga' shas dang*/ de rjes mgon po lha brgyad sbrag sgrub gnang dus mgon pos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rtags dang*/ mnal lam gyi tshul du sa phyogs 'di 'drar 'gro don 'byung sogs kyi lung bstan thob/ slar ri shing du thugs sgrub kyi bsnyen pa gnang dus/ khang bzang mthon po'i rtser slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la phod ka gsol zhing*/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa dang mjal ba'i gsal snang byung gsungs/ de skabs sa skyong dpon g.yog mchod yon gyis thugs rtsol gnang nas/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa/ pad gdan yan la mtho tshad gsum/

yod pa zhig bzhengs/ nang bzhugs rgyas pa gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bar du legs par grub/ rab tu gnas pa rje nyid kyi phyag phyir bla ma slob dpon sde snod 'dzin pa mang dag pa dang bcas pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i zhal phye/ rab gnas rgyas par gnang skabs me tog gi char/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim sogs byung zhing*/ sbyin bdag bsgo ba'i skabs sa skyong dpon blon 'khor bcas zab sprod rgyas pa dang bcas phebs par bkra shis rdzas brgyad 'bul ba sogs shis brjod gnang skabs/ gdung brgyud 'phel zhing mnga' thang rgyas pa'i dge mtshan byung*/ sde srid nas rab tu gnas pa'i yon yang sku gsung thugs rten spus gtsang ba/ gser dngul byu ru dang sbos shel gyi shal pa sogs spus gtsang ba phul/ bla sgrub bla slob dge 'dun gyi sde sogs la yang 'bul ba gya nom pa byung ste/ bkra shis dga' ston gyi yun ring du dus 'da' bar gyur/ de'i phyi lo rgyal bu bltams pa'i mtshan yang rje nyid kyis 'dogs par mdzad de kun dga' rnam rgyal du gsol/ sku khrus yang yang phul/ sku tshe'i legs lam spel phyir tshe dbang grub rgyal ma dang lha dgu/ sgrol dkar bar chad bsrung phyir/ phyag rdor dang mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang sogs bstsal/ glang lo'i dbyar chos la chos sde chen por dmar khrid tshe khrid paṇa chen rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung sogs gnang skabs mnal ltas la/ nyi ma sgra gcan gyis bsgribs pa sogs ngan pa dang*/ thun gtor bya rog gis mi za ba sogs byung bas/ da lo dogs cha gcig rang 'dug gsungs/ ston rgyab dbus gtsang nas rje rin po che'i bka' shog phebs don/ ngos kyang gzugs po bde mo mi 'dug pas yun ring sdod par mi 'dug na'ang*/ 'dir 'phral gyi g.yog sogs 'phan nges yong ba 'dug pas/ khyed rang 'phral du yong pa'i tsab tsob ma byed/ nged kyis rjes su 'dzin gsungs pa byung bas/

thugs shin tu skyo na yang thugs dam phebs sgo dang bstun pas 'phral du phebs ma nus/ sku rim yang yang gnang kyang*/ dbon drung rin po ches/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa stag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la sprul pa'i snang ba bsdu ba gnang ba'i tshul gyis bang chen ched btang byung bas/ re zhig thugs la bzod glags med par gyur kyang*/ bla ma rje btsun dag pa'i zhing du phebs pa la dgongs pa rdzogs phyir mchod 'bul ma gtogs/ 'jig rten lugs kyi mya ngan bya mi rigs par dgongs/ chos sde chen pos gtsos pa'i glo bo nang gi dgon pa rnams dang*/ byang dgon rnams dang*/ dol phyogs kyi dgon pa thams cad la bsnyen bkur 'bul ba/ skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gtong dpag med gnang zhing*/ khyad par gur brtags saṃ gsum bde gsang dang lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye/ rje nyid kyi kyai rdo rje'i tshogs dbu gnang ste bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad par gsal btab pa la mchod 'bul gsol btab gnang*/ gzhan yang sde srid dpon blon sogs che dgu kun gyis mchod 'bul rgyas par gnang ba'i tshogs dbu gnang nas mchod bsngo rgyas par phul/ de dag gi skabs su mnal lam du rje dam pa phebs nas/ bla ma'i sku 'dra brgya rtsa bzhengs na phan yon che gsungs pa byung bas/ sku 'dra brgya rtsa'i bris sku 'di 'phral du bzhengs pa gnang*/ de grub mtshams rje dam pa mnal lam du phebs nas/ 'di la rab gnas nga rang gis byas pa yin pas rab gnas zur pa byed mi dgos gsungs/ chos lung du mi 'phral mar ched gtad du gnang nas/ sku gdung rin po cher snyan dar dkar me/ mchod 'bul rnams la bsnyen bkur 'bul ba dang bcas pa'i chas/ chos lung jo nang shud khrod rnams su mang ja dang bcas gnang*/ de rjes brten bzhengs kyi rgyur gser dngul zangs sogs gtos che ba 'bul ba dge slong bsrung skyobs rdzongs lta gnang*/

de nas rten bzhengs non pa gzhir bcas gnang nas stag lo'i dgun shar la phebs nas/ gzhis byang rgyang gsum bka' gros su bstun pa'i rkang len byang nas gnang*/ ri khrod chen po jo nang gi gdan sa gnang dgos tshul gyi snyan zhus kyi zhu yig dang bcas gdan 'dren pa rnams dang byang lam mgron chen du mjal/ phebs lam bde bar byang ngam ring du phebs/ chos rgyal kun dga' rin chen dang mjal/ jo nang gi gdan sa gnang dgos pa sogs kyi bka' gros rgyas pa byung*/ mched grogs dpal ba sogs rje btsun rin po che'i phyag g.yog rnams dang*/ smon gro nas phyag g.yog drag kha rnams kyang ngam ring du phebs bsu 'byor pa bzhin rim pas brgyud de dpon drung 'phan ne dpon g.yog gis phebs bsu gzabs ma dang bcas smon gror phebs/ zhag gnyis bzhugs chos lung byang chub rtse mor grub sde chen po'i ser sbengs rgyas pas spyan drangs nas phebs/ thugs rtsol che bas dngul gdung rin po che khri thog tu phebs grub 'dug

/der gus 'dud chen pos phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par mdzad de/ snyan dar du gos ljang khu mu tig gi lañca bkod pa cha/ gos 'phan dmar po mu tig rgyan can cha/ gu gu sha'i maṇ+ḍal/ dngul ting bdun tshar/ dngul gyi kong bu dkar me rgyun 'bar dang bcas pa/ sgrub sder mang ja 'gyed sogs gnang*/ rje rdo ring ba dang mjal/ thugs mnyes pa'i gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang*/ de mtshams gzhis rgyang byang gsum so so'i zhu yig mi sna dang bcas rgyu mtshan phul te/ rje nyid dgung lo lnga bcu nga lngar phebs pa rab byung zhes pa me mo yos lo ri khrod chen mo'i nang du sgrub sde'i phebs bsu rgyas pa dang bcas spyan drangs/ kun mkhyen chen po rton pa bzhi ldan sogs mkhas grub rim par byon pa'i khri thogarje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdan sa dron mor rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ sde srid go gsum gyi mang ja dang 'bul chas gzab ma bsko 'jag dang bcas phul/ de nas gting skyes/ smon gro khri snar gdong dga' sogs tha dad nas khri ston phul/ de gong du chos bdag sman btsun ma babs nas/ ngas bla ma'i grabs byas zin nyi myur 'byon rgyu yin zer ba byung*/ de mtshams bla ma gong ma'i phyag srol ltar sbyor drug gi khrid dbu btsugs/ phyogs kyi khrid gsar pa stobs che ba dang bcas la sngon 'gro'i skabs/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rnams kyi rnam thar gyi lung*/ mchog dbang gi skabs dbang zhu mi bdun brgya 'gror nges shes pa byung*/ sor sdud dang bsam gtan gyi khrid ngo sprod dang bcas pa grub nas/ zla ba gnyis tsam sku mtshams dam pa gnang nas bzhugs skabs mnal lam la rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa sku chos ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan gsol ba/ sku gzi brjid che zhing zhal 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pas/

phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi 'khor lo zhig gnang nas 'gro ba rnams thar lam la 'god pa zhig bya dgos gsungs pa zhig gi ngang la mnal lam sad pas/ bla ma dran pa dang dad pas spu longs g.yo ba byung gsungs/ gzhan yang dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid dang*/ sna tshogs yum/ sman btsun ma'i srog dbang sogs gnang*/ der glo bo nas sde pa dpon blon lha sde mi sde kun gyis gdan 'dren byung bas thog mar dbus phyogs su phebs/ de rjes phebs pa'i bka' gnang*/ dus 'di nas bzung rje btsun rin po che'i phyag g.yog drag pa rnams rje 'di byang phyogs la phebs dus phyag g.yog la 'khrid/ rgyun du chos lung du dpon drung rin po ches zhabs togs gnang ba mchog gi sprul pa'i sku nyid nam phebs kyi bar la gnang*/ phebs nas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku nyid kyi phyag phyir phul/ phyag g.yog tu gtogs tsam yan chad bar ma dor ma lhung bar mgo 'don bdag rkyen mthar phyin par gnang ngo*/ /de nas dpon slob rnams bsam grub rtser phebs/ zhabs drung rgyal bu ngag dbang nor bu bzang po dang mjal/ sku mdun zhal ngo sogs la bka' dbang gnang*/ legs lam che ba'i mu nas gser mdog can du phebs/ mkhan rin po che dpal mchog bzang po sogs kyis dad gus kyis mchod/ dngul gdung rin po che/ sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu/ rje btsun byams mgon sogs dang*/ lam 'bras lha khang*/ mgon khang sogs kyi rten mjal dang*/ rten byin rlabs can de rnams la snyan dar dkar me phul/ mang ja bsngo rten rnam gzhag dang bcas pa gnang nas pho brang chen po rin chen spungs par phebs/ sa'i brgya byin ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug grags pa steng zhal dang mjal/ legs tshogs che ba nas rong chen brgyud smug lar phebs/ sde pa dpon blon gyis phebs bsu dang zhabs tog dad mos rtse gcig pas bsgrubs/ rim gyis lha sar phebs jo shāka rnam gnyis rang byon lnga ldan sogs la zhal gser snyan dar/

gzhan lha khang thams cad du yang dkar me lhag par rje btsun gong ma lnga/ kun mkhyen chen po'i sku 'dra rnams la snyan dar dkar me phul nas glang thang du phebs/ rten 'jal gnang zhing tshogs la mang ja bsngo rten dang*/ gdan sa bas gtsos pa 'ga' shas la chos 'brel gnang*/ lcang lung chos sdings dang chos 'khor rtse sogs su phebs te/ lcang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros dang*/ bka' drin can gzhon nu chos grub/ paṇa chen rdor rgyal ba sogs kyi sku 'dra dang nang rten rnams la snyan dar mchod me sogs phul/ smon lam rgya cher 'debs pa gnang*/ dgon gnas gnyis por mang ja dang bsngo rten stsal nas byang stag lung du phebs/ rje kun dga' bkra shis dang mjal/ stong rdzas la brten pa'i 'bul ba rgya cher phul/ de rjes grogs khar rje ras pa chen po rnam rgyal phun tshogs dang mjal bka' 'brel gsan/ de rjes stag lung nas rje sku mched gnyis kas bka' chos dgos gsungs nan skyed che ba nas so sor tshe dbang lha dgu/ grub rgyal ma brgya tshar/ dus 'khor snyan rgyud kyi khrid/ rnam sras dkar po'i rjes gnang sogs 'bul ba gnang*/ stag lung gi che dgu gzhan rnams dang*/ khra khyu ba/ smug chu ba sogs khang tshan so sos kyang 'bul ba dpag tu med pa phul zhing*/ so sor tshe dbang*/ dzaṃ dmar/ mgon dkar sogs 'dod chos gnang*/ ra sgreng du phebs/ gnas brten khyad par can thams cad mjal zhing phyag mchod gnang nas slar stag lung du phebs/ rje sku mched kyi gtsos thams cad kyis 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul/ phyir phebs te lcang lung sogs gang phebs kyi dgon gnas rnams su mang ja dang rten rnams la mchod pa 'bul bzhin pas sna dkar rtser phebs/ zhabs tog dpe med pa byung*/ gzhis ka rin spungs su phebs/ sde srid zhal ngo rnams dang mjal/ ra lnga rtser dpon sa bdag mo'i drung du thugs bzhed ltar tshe dbang sgrol dkar/ mgon po'i bka' bsgo sogs phul/

bka' nan che ba nas gza' skar dge ba la/ mi'i dbang po yab sras rnams la tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ lha dgu rnam sras dkar po dus 'khor lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs phul ba gnang rjes/ g.yung la brgyud rgyal mkhar rtser phebs/ sde pa dang mjal/ bzhugs gdan sogs bkur bsti chen po mdzad/ li ma lha khang sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung sogs mjal/ mchod sde'i bla brang dkar por zhabs tog cher zhus/ de nas rtse chen chos sder spyan 'dren dang bstun phebs/ tshogs su dus 'khor lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang*/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i dngul gdung la snyan dar/ dkar me/ phyag mchod smon lam gnang nas/ sho ma ri chung ngu*/ grub chen kun blo'i gdung rten mjal/ khri khang du phebs/ sde pa grwa lnga yab sras la tshe dbang dang*/ dzam dkar sogs gnang nas snar thang du phebs/ sde pa la tshe dbang sogs gnang*/ chos sde'i rten mjal phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par mdzad nas ri khrod chen por phebs/ dgun khrid rgyas pa ngo sprod dang bcas pa dang*/ grol khar khrom chen po la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ thugs rje chen pa'i sgom lung dang bcas gnang ngo*/ /zhabs sen sin+dhu wa ra'i klung brgya pas/ /dbang po kun sim rkang sbas snying po'i rdul/ / byin rlabs bdud rtsir 'babs pas gdul bya rnams/ /kun dkris tsha gdung zhi la zla ba bzhin/ /bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i sems mchog gis/ /'gro kun rang las gces par 'dzin pa'i lugs/ /byams pa chen po'i chu bos dgra sde yi/ khro ba'i 'dam rdzab skem par mdzad 'dir mtshar/ /gzung 'dzin dag pa'i ting 'dzin mkha' dbyings su/ /rigs lnga'i 'ja' tshon ri mo rnam bkra zhing*/ /rdo rje'i sngags kyi na da glur blangs bas/ / gzhom med nus pa'i snying po mngon du gyur/ /lus dang ngag yid rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /snang srid bde chen mchog gi rol bar shar/ /de las gnas gsum mkha' 'gros gus btud de/

/rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi khyab bdag mdzad/ /rje btsun mchog gi byin rlabs nor bu'i phreng*/ /spyi bor bkod pa'i skad cig de nyid la/ /grub rig 'dzin pa kun dang skal mnyam pa'i/ /spangs rtogs yon tan kun gyi mdzod du gyur/ /de tshe rje btsun bla ma dam pa des/ /byin rlabs cod paṇa gang gi gtsug bcings nas/ /sku'i rgyal tshab mchog tu dbang bskur nas/ /de nyid dag pa'i zhing khams chen por bzhud/ /de yi thugs dgongs rgya mtsho bskang pa'i slad/ /kun du bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho las/ /nye bar 'ongs pa mchod pa'i char chen gyis/ /srid pa yangs pa'i khong kyang yongs su gang*/ /rton pa bzhi ldan chen po'i seṅge'i khri/ /rje btsun mchog gi zhabs rdul gyis gtsang bar/ /gang khyod mngon par 'dzeg nas nges don gyi/ / chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'gog pa med par bsgrags/ /de nas mnga' ris la phebs pa'i dgongs rtse gtad de chos lung byang rtser phebs/ dngul gdung rin po cher bkra shis kha btags nyin bde ma sum sbrel dang*/ gos yug gi na bza'/ gzhan ma sku so sor yang snyan dar dkar me sogs phul/ phyag mchod smon lam rgyas pa mdzad/ tshogs la mang ja 'gyed bcas gnang*/ smon gror phebs/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ zang zing gi gnang sbyin bslab ston zhib rgyas gnang*/ mgon khang du mchod rdzas phul zhing bskang gso rgyas par gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ rdor 'dzin pa dang gtso mo gsum gyis gtsos pa la/ nged myur stabs su slebs par byed pas de bar la dbyar mtshams dgun mtshams sogs bsgrigs rnams sngar las ma g.yos par byed dgos pa'i bslab ston rgyas pa dang tshogs la mang ja dang bcas pa gnang*/ mnga' ris phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur/ dgon pa bde chen du khrom dbang gnang*/ lha rtser bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po dang mjal/ sku rim du bskang gso brgya tshar gnang nas rim gyis ngam ring du chos rgyal kun dga' rin chen dang mjal/

lam gyi dgos cha mtha' dag phul/ skya skyar phebs/ chos rje byang ri bas zhabs tog zhus shing 'dod chos mang du gnang*/ rim pas brgyud glo bo nang du thog ma re shing du phebs/ de nas thub bstan dar rgyas gling du phebs te/ dge 'dun tshogs chen gyis gdugs rgyal mtshan/ ba dan lda ldi/ phye phur/ rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yas pa thogs pa'i ser sbreng zab rgyas/ skye bo'i tshogs kyis skya rags dang bcas pas gdan drangs/ rten so sor snyan dang dkar me sogs mchod rdzas/ tshogs su mang ja 'gyed bcas gzabs ma sogs sku skyes rgyas pa bstsal/ de nas smon thang rgyal po'i pho brang du bsu ba'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas phebs/ chos rgyal bsod nams rgyal po dang mjal/ sngar bas kyang sri zhu cher gnang*/ rgyal bu la tshe dbang sogs bstsal/ de nas rnam rgyal rtser phebs nas tshe dpal drung sogs la tshe dbang rigs mi gcig pa mang po dang 'dzam ser nagarnam 'joms sogs rjes gnang mang dag gnang de nas las pa blo ldan dang*/ slob dpon bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma slob dpon 'ga' shas la sgyu lus dbang mo ches sgo phyes te ni gu chos drug gi khrid/ gzhan yang khrid brgya dang*/ paṇa chen rin po che dang rje rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung*/ tshogs chen la blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid/ mi dmangs la khrom chos sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ slar rnam rgyal rtser rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung bsnyen sbyin sreg dang bcas pa dang*/ dpa' bo dur khrod bdag po'i ljags bsnyen mdzad dus de nyid dngos su zhal gzigs/ de nas 'tshar dgar phebs/ 'tshar kha rab 'byams pa chos skyong rdo rje la khong rang gi 'dod chos dang mthun par dbus smyon gyi rnam thar dang*/ rje dam pa'i rnam thar gyi lung gnang*/ de nas bar bong brag dmar du phebs/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud dang dbang*/ tshe khrid sogs gsung chos mang dag gnang*/

bar bong dgon gsar du phebs/ drung yon dar ba dpon slob rnams la rjes gnang 'ga' yar dang*/ ri chos skor gsum gyi lung gnang*/ rje nyid kyis kyang drung sa yon dar ba la/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa nas brgyud pa'i rgyud 'bum dang*/ nag po gzhung drug gi lung sogs gsan/ ko mong du phebs/ de sogs gang phebs su khrom chos tshe dbang dang thugs rje chen po'i bzlas lung gnang*/ bya tshang chos sder mkhan po bsod nams dpal 'byor gyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba gzabs ma dang bcas pas gdan drangs/ sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang*/ mkhan chen mnyam med kyi rnam thar lung gnang*/ slar ko mang du phebs/ dol phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon/ dol gru bzhir dbang gnang nas/ kun mkhyen chen po'i 'khrungs yul spu ru phebs/ gser mchod dar cog 'dzug pa gnang dus/ mnga' ris su gtan nas mi yong ba la/ bya skya ka gcig kun gyis mthong*/ de sman btsun ma'i bsu bar dgongs/ de nas dgon pa grwa lung du chos rje rnam grol dpon slob gyis bsu ba rgyas pas spyan drangs/ chos rje la tshe dbang brgya rtsa lha dgu ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang*/ ku ru kul+le'i khrid/ sgrol dkar gyi khrid/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skye bcu gcig gi rtogs brjod dang rnam thar chen mo'i lung gnang*/ rje nyid kyis kyang gu ru drag dmar gyi dbang lung*/ phyag bzhi pa dang*/ mgon ser gyi skor rnams gsan/ de nas byang rnam rgyal lha rtser phebs/ chos dgon gsum gyi phebs bsu gzabs rgyas bcas/ bla brang du phebs mkhan po lha mchog bas gtsos pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha stag 'dus pa la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma/ lha dgu mi 'khrugs pa kyai rdo rje yab bka'/ yum bka' rnams gnang*/ byang dgon tha dad kyi bsnyen rdzogs zhu mi mang po byung ba la/ rje nyid kyis mkhan po/

chos rje lha mchog gis slob dpon/ rab 'byams pa rab brtan gyis gsang ston/ rab 'byams pa mthar legs kyis dus bsgo ba byas/ kha skong gi dge 'dun dang bcas/ bsgrub bya mang po la bsnyen rdzogs gnang nas spong ler phebs/ bo zi gnyis 'dus la dbang rjes gnang lung mang ngag gnang*/ de sogs dgon pa gang phebs thams cad du mang ja/ bsngo rten 'tshogs chos khrom chos sogs gnang ngo*/ /de nas glo bo nang du phebs nas chos sde chen por bzhugs/ de'i dgun la bal po ku su 'ju dang zangs 'ju sogs mkhas pa mang dag gis rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i nang rten/ rnam rgyal mchod rten mtho tshad che ba zhig gser zangs las bzhengs pa gnang*/ sbrul lo zla ba bdun pa'i nang du grub/ de'i tshes brgyad nyi ma me bzhi'i nyin rab gnas rje nyid kyis gnang ba'i phyag phyir las pa blo ldan sogs slob dpon dang dge slong nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam gyis kyai rdo rje'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas bla ma gong ma'i phyag len bzhin rgyas par gnang skabs/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur me tog gi char sogs phyi nang gi ltas ngo mtshar ba du ma byung*/ sde srid kyi gtsos pa'i che dgu kun gyis dga' ston rgya cher phul/ bal po rnams bkon skyon/ byu gser gyi dod po gser rkyang dang gzhan yang gnang sbyin dpag med bstsal bas yid mgu ba thob par gyur/ rab gnas phyag g.yog pa slob dpon lnga la zangs lcags/ ras sngo dmar dar kha re/ cho ga ba bying la/ zangs lcags ja rnams zho re/ ras snam bu dar rnams zho gnyis re gnang*/ gser gdung la gos dar gyi na bza'/ mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur/ sde pa bla dpon rnams bkra shis dga' ston la spyan drangs/ de thams cad la tsā ru'i bza' ba bzang zhing rgya che ba dang*/ skye bo'i tshogs mtha' yas pa la sbyin gtong rgya cher gnang*/ gtang rag tu chos skyong la bskang gso mnga' gsol rgyas par gnang*/

de nas mkhan khang du sku mtshams zla ba gcig tsam mdzad de grol mtshams tshogs pa la snying po don gsum gyi khrid/ ni gu'i khrid/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ yig cha gsar rnying rnams kyi lung*/ ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang gnang nas smon thang du phebs/ dpon drung tha dad/ drung skor drag bsdus skor rnams la tshe dbang*/ rnam sras/ mgon po lha brgyad sogs dbang rjes gnang mang bar gnang*/ de nas rnam rgyal rtser zla ba gsum gyi bar du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ljags bsnyen sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gnang*/ da res kyi mtshams 'di gsal snang che zhing rje btsun mas rjes su 'dzin pa'i ltas kyang byung gsungs pa'i bka' phebs/ de nas chos sde'i sgrub mchod rgyas pa'i gtso bor phebs/ dkyil 'khor rgya che zhing steng du bla bre/ 'khor yug tu si ta hūs thag pa la gos dar yug gdang 'gel gyi lda ldi/ gzhan yang 'phan gtor gur sogs grangs mang ba dang*/ dar yol nyis sbrag gis bskor ba'i dbus su dpon slob 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams bzhugs pa'i re re la yang dbu rgyan gser ma/ dar dpyangs/ rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod snod thod bzang po/ rten khebs bzang sgrigs sogs ma tshang ba med pa mdzad/ dbang rdzas dang mchod pa'i bkod pa rnams ma nyams par lo ltar bzhin dgos pa'i bka' bkod bstsal

la / de ltar sgrub mchod rgyas pa gnang ba grol ba'i rdul mtshon spyan 'dren gyi dus su/ dung dkar/ rgya gling*/ phra dung*/ sbom dung*/ sil snyan/ rnga bo che sogs rol mo mang ba/ gdugs sum thog ma dang nyis thog bdun tshar re/ gdugs thog gcig ma bdun tshar gnyis/ rgyal mtshan/ 'phyar dar phye phur sogs grangs mang ba/ dri bzang gi dud sprin dang bcas chu bo chen por spyan 'dren mdzad/ 'khor mtshams chos skyong la gtang rag gi mchod gtor rgya cher mdzad cing*/ pu ṭa pho mo/ ru 'dren/ dur khrod bdag po sogs kyi mtshams dpal ldan sa skya'i phyag len bzhin mdzad/ de'i sos ka byang spong ler phebs nas/ tsha rong nam mkha' blo gsal gdan sa'i bsko bzhag gnang*/ rnam rgyal lha rtse brgyud nas chos sde chen por phebs/ de mtshams dbus gtsang nas jo nang chos khrims pa sogs la byang bdag po'i zhu yig dang bcas gdan 'dren rnams slebs/ der bskang gso rgyas par mdzad skabs/ dgong mo'i mchod gtor dang rgyan gyi thugs dam rnams grol nas mtshan phyed tsam song ba na/ mnal gyis srab srib kyi ngang du rol mo'i sgra'i rnam pa zhig byung*/ de la snyan gtad ring du sha chen gyi dud pas gzims chung khengs byung bas/ chos skyong dgyes pa'i mtshan ma byung gsungs pa/ de skabs mgon po 'khor bcas zhal gzigs par gdon mi za yang gsal bar mi gsungs zhes sku gzhogs pa rnams gsungs/ de nas shar phyogs su phebs pa la/ sde pa dpon blon/ chos sde mi sde thams cad kyis yar lo gcig tsam nas phebs dgos pa'i zhu ba nan can byung nas/ yar khyug tsam phebs pa'i bka' bzhes gnang*/ der rje nyid kyi sku'i dbon po sku chos gnang*/ de dang skya skyar sgang pa'i zhal ngo gcig kyang rab byung mdzad/ de ltar chos mdzad gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i so ma stobs chen dang bcas byang li rtser phebs/ chos rje nam mkha' blo gsal sku mched la tshe dbang sgrol dkar sogs gnang nas skya skyar phebs/

byang ri chos rje rgyal mtshan mchog grub sku mched la tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub/ ni gu'i khrid bsdus pa rnams gnang*/ ngam ring du phebs chos rgyal kun dga' rin chen gyis gzhi len rgyas par mdzad/ lha rtse brgyud nas ri khrod chen por phebs/ sgrub sde'i ser sbrengs rgyas pas spyan drangs/ thebs 'phral la phyag dbang gnang*/ sang nas sku 'khyos su mang ja 'bras 'jam 'gyed/ lha khang so sor snyan dar 'bul ba gnang nas/ smon gror spyan drangs/ bka' dbang dang dngos po'i sku 'khyos gnang*/ chos lung byang rtser phebs bsu zab rgyas dang bcas te phebs/ dngul gdung rin po cher sman tshe yug /gos 'phan cha/ dkar me brgya kong sogs mchod rdzas rgya che ba dang*/ tshogs pa la mang ja nyis sbrel 'gyed bcas gnang rjes/ slar ri khrod chen por phebs/ chos mdzad bcu gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i so ma rnams mang ja dang bcas grwa sa chen por rdzongs ltar gnang nas/ rta lo'i dgun 'khrid 'dzug pa gnang*/ de grol nas gting skyes nas spyan 'dren byung nas dbyar chos grol nas phebs pa gnang*/ phar lam gdong sgar nang so bstan pa sku mched yab sras kyis gtsos pa'i chibs rags kyis phebs bsu dang chos sde ser sbrengs dang bcas phebs/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang sogs 'dod chos gnang*/ rim gyis gting skyes mkhar chen rtser phebs/ chos sde gsum gyis ser sbrengs dang*/ sde pa zhal ngos gtsos pa'i chibs rags kyis phebs bsu mdzad/ chos sde so sor mang ja bsngo rten/ sde pa yab sras la gnang skyes rgyas par gnang*/ brag dkar du sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rin chen gyi sku gdung dang*/ trak+shad kyi mgon khang mjal/ snyan dar dkar me sogs 'bul ba gnang*/ de dus mgon po'i sku'i thad nas gos chen lcags nag kha gang mdun du rang babs su byung ba sogs rten 'brel rang 'grig tu gyur/ chos grwar phebs/

zhal ngo rnams la sgrol dkar rnam 'joms rnams kyi rjes gnang khrus chog dang bcas pa tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya tshar/ tshe 'khrid tshe dpag med lha dgu ma brgya tshar/ tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gnang dus/ tshe mda' mtho gang tsam 'phel pas thugs ya mtshan zhing dgyes par mdzad/ mgon po'i skor mang po dang*/ paṇa chen rin po che dang rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung*/ dgon gsum ka'i dge 'dun tshogs pa la dzaṃ dkar gyi rjes gnang*/ paṇa chen rin po che'i sku bstod rnams kyi lung*/ gshin gyi gdung brgyud 'gro mgon dpon slob rnams ched gtad mjal bar phebs/ khong gis nan zhus mdzad nas kyai rdo rje'i rgyud dbang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ tshe dbang*/ dzaṃ lha dkar po'i rjes gnang sogs mang ba dang*/ chos sde'i drag pa rnams dang*/ drung 'khor rags bsdus rnams la yang gang la gang 'dod kyi bka' chos gnang*/ zla ba drug tsam bzhugs nas/ phyir phebs dus rnam sras dkar po dang*/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i rjes gnang phebs skyel rim can du byung*/ dgong gcig tshul phebs mtshams gting skyes nas phul ba'i chibs pa de 'grogs nas phar shor ba la rta bas ded kyang ma zin pa la/ mgon khyi rjes la brgyugs nas tshur bkug pas ya mtshan par byung*/ de nas gdong rgar phebs/ nang so zhal ngo rnams la bka' chos gnang nas dgon pa bde chen du phebs/ lha rtse nas ma chen he pa sogs drag pa thams cad mjal du byung ba la/ tshe rta sogs gnang nas/ jo nang du phebs phral bo dong gnyer pa/ shel dkar nang so yab sras sogs mjal mkhan mang dag byung ba la/ so so'i 'dod chos dang mthun pa'i bka' chos gnang nas chos lung byang rtser phebs/ dngul dung rin po cher snyan dar dkar me phyag mchod sgrub sde la mang ja 'gyed bcas gnang*/ tshogs chos su bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ rtsa dbu ma'i khrid/

rje btsun kun dga' mchog grub kyi bka' 'bum 'dod 'jo'i lung rnams gnang*/ smon gror phebs sku skyes gnang sbyin gnang nas/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ khrus chog /sgyu lus dbang mo che/ ni gu'i khrid phyag drug pa dang gur gyi bka' bsgo gnang nas ri khrod chen mor phebs/ dgun 'khrid phyogs tha dad kyi dpon skya che chung*/ khrid gsar pa stobs che ba dang bcas pa la sngar ltar gnang*/ ngo sprod kyi skabs gzhis ka rgyal rtse/ byang ngam ring ba sogs nas mang ja 'gyed bcas bsngo rten sogs gtos che bar byung*/ dgun smad sku mtshams gnang skabs/ byang stag lung nas gdan 'dren nan tan byung ba la/ dbyar chos grol mthar phebs pa'i bka' bzhes gnang*/ dbyar chos la dmar 'khrid sbyor tsha ma dang*/ nges don rgya mtsho'i lung gnang*/ dbus la phebs/ gdong du rdor 'dzin pa sogs drag bsdus rnams la/ nged gtsug lag khang 'di zhig gsos byed 'dod yod pas/ shing cha rags pa kha yar gcod dgos 'dug cing*/ las mgo nam btsug pa dga' ba'i bka' gros gnang nas/ khong rnams kyi zhu cha/ 'di kun mkhyen gyi phyag nas ma yin pa dang*/ shing cha phal cher chos skyong gi spyan gzigs yin pas mi legs sam zhu ba byung bas/ gtsug lag khang bshig rang dgos pa'i nges pa med/ zhig gso byed dgos gsungs/ rje nyid rang gi shing sta bsnams nas sdong po gsum bzhi la gnang*/ da bcad na skyon mi yong gsungs pa dang*/ gnyer la tshogs gdan rnams bsgril la phugs su zhog dbyar char bas skyon zhig yod gsungs pa nan gyis byung*/ tshogs pa la mang ja 'gyed sogs/ gnang nas shar la chibs kha bsgyur/ lam bar gyi sde dpon so sos kyang spyan 'dren pa slebs nas/ thog mar snar thang du phebs/ sde pa la dbang byin rlabs mang du gnang nas khri khang du phebs/ sde pa yab sras rnams la tshe dbang grub rgyal la/ tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun ma/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyu da dbang*/

lam dbang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ rjes gnang mang bar gnang nas rim pas brgyud/ gzhis ka rin spungs su phebs/ yab sras sta ེ nga zhal rnams dang mjal dpal tshe dpag med dkar po/ grub rgyal ma dang lha dgu brgya rtsa re re/ thub pa me ru sidha'i tshe sgrub/ sgrol dkar/ mi g.yo ba sogs rjes gnang mang ba/ dzam+bha la dmar po'i byin rlabs/ dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang*/ rnam 'joms dza li ma dkar po'i byab bsrung rnams phul/ ngur smrig tu sgrol ma mjal nas rong chen brgyud/ smyug lar phebs tshe dbang dzam ser sogs rjes gnang 'ga' dang*/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar gyi lung gnang*/ gzhis ka gong dkar nas yum sras kyis spyan drangs/ dgongs bzhed ltar tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ rnam rgyal dzaṃ bha la rigs lnga'i rjes gnang*/ tshe dbang lha dgu sogs 'bul ba gnang*/ de skabs jo nang gi gtsug lag khang phyogs nas zhig pas/ rdor 'dzin pa sogs kun gyis 'di rje rang gis dgongs pa 'dug zer ya mtshan zhing*/ sku gzhogs su bang chen byung*/ de nas lha sar phebs/ jo bo rin po cher bkra shis kha btags zung gis snyan dar/ dar chen gyi snam sbyar/ gzhan ma jo bo bcu gcig zhal sogs rten gtso so sor snyan dar/ dkar me gzhan yang gur gum/ li sug dzā ti/ tsan+dan dang a ga ru'i phye ma gser gyi phye ma dang bsres pa sku so sor 'thor ba dang*/ spos kyi dud sprin sogs kyis mchod/ smon lam thugs tshim par gnang nas/ lcang lung chos sdings su mkhan chen karma bzang po dpon slob kyis ser sbrengs rgyas pas spyan drangs/ rig 'dzin lo brgya ba lcang lung pa chen po dang*/ bka' drin can rje btsun gzhon nu chos grub kyi sku sogs la snyan dar dang mchod pa dpag med gnang*/ tshogs pa la tshogs chos mang ja 'gyed bcas dang mkhan chen rang la tshe dbang lha dgu sogs gnang*/ stag lung nas phebs bsu dang bcas phebs/ rje rin po che kun dga' bkra shis pa dang mjal/

gur gum sogs sman bzang drugagaser srang gang*/ byu ru spos shel/ ras spus gtsang ba sogs stod zog spus gtsang mang pos sku skyes phul/ de nas rje grogs kha pa chen po dang mjal/ sku skyes sngar bzhin phul/ stag lung ba'i che btsun kun gyis phyag mjal phul/ de nas rje kun dga' bkra shis las tshe dbang dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang*/ stag lung thang pa chen po'i rnam thar gyi lung gsan/ de nas rje nyid la tshe dpag med dkar po/ sgrol dkar 'jam dkar/ grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ dze tā ri dgra las rnam rgyal gyi bka' srol/ sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa'i tshe dpag med lha dgu'i 'chi blu dang bcas pa/ tshe khrid dzaṃ dmar/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skye bcu gcig gi rtogs brjod/ rnam thar yongs rdzogs mgur 'bum dang bcas pa'i lung phul/ rje grogs kha ba chen po tshe dbang rigs mi gcig pa 'ga' shas/ bka' gdams thor bu pa dang*/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar chen mo'i lung phul/ cog grwa slob dpon pas gtsos pa'i don gnyer mang dag la/ snying po don gsum gyi 'khrid byings pa rnams la rang rang gi 'dod pa'i rjes gnang lung sogs gnang*/ de nas rwa sgreng mjal bar phebs/ jo bo la dkar me/ zhal gser/ snyan dar phyag mchod smon lam gnang nas slar stag lung du phebs/ rje sku mched la ku ru kul+le'i gsang 'khrid/ gur gyi rjes gnang*/ man ngag zab mo dang bcas pa gnang*/ dpon rin po che sogs drag pa rnams la yang tshe dbang sogs dang*/ so sor 'dod chos mang ba gnang*/ de nas stag lung nas dpon slob so sos 'bul ba rgya che ba rang mdzad/ de nas lhun grub sgang du phebs/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang rta mgrin sogs gnang*/ tshur yong lcang lung chos sdings su phebs/ mkhan rin po che dang spyi chos dgos chos sogs gnang nas lha sar phebs/ zhal gser gser ston rgyas pa bcas snyan dar sogs so sor 'bul ba gnang*/

rim gyis rong ngur smrig dang*/ gzhis ka byams chen sogs kyi rten mjal gnang nas/ gzhis ka rin spungs su phebs nas sde srid dang mjal/ rgyang tsam bzhugs nas dgongs bzhed ltar tshe dbang sogs dbang bka' rjes gnang mang ba/ dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi 'khrid/ mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang*/ ja bzang dang rdzong kha brgyud khri khang du phebs/ tshe dbang gnang*/ gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ sde pa rgyal bu dpon blon la tshe dbang sogs gnang*/ gser mdog can la mang ja skol ba rdzong dar gnang*/ rim gyis ri khrod chen mor phebs/ lha khang so sor snyan dar mar me/ tshogs pa la mang ja gnang*/ smon 'gro brgyud nas chos lung byang rtser phebs/ dngul gdung rin po cher snyan dar gos yug /rje kun dga' mchog grub kyi sku la sogs pa sku che grwa rnams la snyan dar/ dkar me brgya rtsa sogs mchod pa dang*/ tshogs su mang ja zung sbrel 'gyed bcas/ rje drung rdo ring par bkra shis kha btags/ gser srang*/ dngul phor/ gos phyi nang*/ ja sigs 'bul ba gnang*/ rgyang tsam bzhugs ring rje rin po che la tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs/ gsan yig 'khrid brgya'i lung rnams phul/ tshur yang tshe dbang*/ zhal bzhi pa rigs mi 'dra ba bcu gcig gi rjes gnang lung bcas rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid sogs gsan/ sgrub sde la tshe 'khrid/ rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung rnams gnang ngo*/ /༈ byang chub phyogs chos gzugs su snang ba'i spo/ /rin chen du ma las grub chos sku'i rten/ /nyin byed 'od du 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis/ /rtsod dus mun pa'i tshogs rnams ring du bskrad/ /gang la bde chen 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ / ye shes rang bzhin rje btsun bla ma'i thugs/ /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes spyan drangs pas/ /rdul snyed rgyal ba'i byin rlabs ma lus zhugs/ /sngags rgya ting 'dzin cho ga'i rim pa las/

/lhag gnas me tog gtor tshe phyogs bcu yi/ / rab 'byams zhing gi rgyal ba ma lus pas/ /shis brjod man da ra ba'i phreng ba spel/ /de tshe mkha' dbyings chu 'dzin gos bral bar/ /'ja' tshon phreng bas yongs su bris byas shing*/ /lha rdzas me tog sil ma'i char chen gyis/ /nam mkha' yangs pa ma lus 'gengs par byed/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa drang nges chos kyi tshogs/ /gang la gang 'dul blo dang 'tshams ston zhing*/ /skal ldan mchog la rdo rje theg pa yi/ /nye lam grub pa'i zhal lung gtso bor bstan/ /phyogs bcu'i skye 'gro'i bsod nams gsog phyir du/ /rin thang che ba'i dngos po kun phul ba/ /slar yang mi zad nam mkha' mdzod phye nas/ /dkon mchog mchod dang dman la sbyin gtong mdzad/ /zab mo'i don mchog bskyed rdzogs ye shes la/ /skad cig yengs pa med par mnyam 'jog cing*/ /bsdu dngos bzhi dang pha rol phyin drug gi /spyod pa'i tshul 'di lag len thebs par mdzad/ /mang po'i dbus su kha bshad ne tso'i tshig /yin yin ltar smra'i cher rlom mang mod kyi/ / dam chos chos nas bshad bzhin mdzad pa des/ /rje btsun khyed kyi rnam par thar pa yin/ /de nas slar yang smon gror phebs/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang*/ chos skyong gi bka' bsgo sogs gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon sogs ser skya dad 'dus la rang rang gi bsam pa ltar gyi rjes gnang*/ tshe dbang lung sogs gnang*/ de nas zla ba gnyis tsam sku mtshams gnang ba grol mtshams/ nang so gro lung chos mdzad pa sogs la tshe dbang*/ dmar po skor gsum/ ni gu'i 'khrid sogs gnang rjes/ dgun khrid sogs kyi 'khrid gsar pa gtos che ba dang bcas pa mthar phyin/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa zla sbrel tsam gnang*/ de nas brag dmar chos sde'i mkhan po chos kyi rje don yod rdo rje dpon slob rnams/ paṇa chen rin po che dang rje dam pa nas brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho sogs gsan par cher gtad du phebs zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs par sgrubs thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho gnyis ka'i rjes gnang*/

sla chos su ma song bar rjes gnang rting ma rnams sgrub ring tshogs pas sgrol ma gnang*/ rjes gnang grub 'phral sgrub thabs kyi lung gnang*/ yang dgos rjes gnang rting ma sgrub pa sogs phyag len shin du gtsang ba'i sgo nas gnang*/ gzhan yang rjes gnang zur bka' mang dag dang*/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i lung sogs gnang nas shar la thogs phebs/ ring po ma lon par gser mdog can du gnang 'dug

/de nas nyi ma me bzhi'i 'grub sbyor yod pa zhig gi nyin ri khrod chen po jo nang gi gtsug lag khang gi 'gram bskyed nas gsar du gtsug lag gi bla'i dpon/ chos rje kun bzang rgyal po la bsko bzhag gnang*/ rdo bzo shing bzo sogs gang mkhas nas 'bod pa gnang ste/ gtsug lag khang sngar bas rgya che la dpangs mtho ba'i zhal bkod gnang*/ de nas ring po ma thogs par 'du khang ka chen sum bcu yod pa/ shing cha sogs gzabs ldan phugs thig khang dang bcas pa grub mtshams/ bzo ris pa rnams la gnang sbyin rgya cher gnang nas rdzongs ltar gnang*/ de rjes sprul sku sman thang ba sku mdun blo bzang ba dang lhun grub pa gnyis phyag phyir rgod khungs bsod dpal ba dang*/ snar thang pa tshe ring 'phel sogs mkhas bsdus dpon slob nyi shu phyir phebs/ gtsug lag khang la gzigs nas/ gtsug lag khang che zhing shing cha bzang bsgrigs rang du 'dug pas tshon mang po dgos par 'dug pa la/ gzhis ka rin spungs nas spang mthing gtos che ba 'bul ba gnang 'dug pa 'dis ldangs kyang mtshal li khri stobs chen dgos pa 'dug zhus pas des rang thogs mi 'ong gsungs/ bar chad sel phyir khong dpon slob la tshe dbang dang*/ lha zhi drag gi rjes gnang 'ga' re gnang*/ skya ris tshugs mtshams shel dkar nas sgrub sde chen por mang ja bsnyen bkur/ rje'i drung du 'bul ba spyi dang*/ khyad par logs bris gnang gi yod 'dug pas zer/ mtshal legs pa gro 'bo phyur pa gcig phul byung bas lhag 'thor pa byung*/ shing rtsi logs bris tshang ma tshon bzang*/ gser tsha byugs shing ri mo gzab pa'i ngos/ thub dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i kun mkhyen chen po dang*/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku skye bcu gcigadus kyi 'khor lo zhal phyag rdzogs pa/ chos rgyal rigs ldan/ sbyor drug brgyud pa/ 'dod lha 'ga' shas dang bcas pa rnams ri mo 'bab cing grub skyen pa rang byon lta bur byung nas/

zla ba bzhi lhag pa la bar chad kyi mtshan ma cung zad tsam yang med par mthar phyin/ bzo ris pa rnams kyang rje nyid kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs las grub par 'dug zhu ba byung*/ rab tu gnas par rje nyid phebs dgos pa'i nan zhus byung bas/ ljags bsnyen gyi 'phros gang myur gnang nas zhag drug nas sku mtshams grol nas phebs pas dbon drung rin po che 'phan ne de nyid gshegs pa'i bang chen dang lam du mjal nas myur bar smon gror phebs/ sku rjes rgya cher byed dgos pa'i bka' bkod gnang ste rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku dang*/ rje rdo ring pa yar 'brog na bzhugs pa la 'bul ba dang spyan 'dren sbrags pa/ gzhan stag lung chos rje sogs chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma kun la 'bul ba/ chos lung byang rtser snyan dar dang dkar me sogs gtos che ba smon 'gro rang du chos lung*/ shug khro/ dgon pa dkar po ba/ jo nang sgrub sde rags pa*/ gser mdog can gyi phu thug pa'i slob gnyer ba sogs dge 'dun sum brgya bud pas dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod dang smon lam mdzad/ rje nyid dpon slob nyung bsdus kyis rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga gnang*/ mthar dge 'dun thams cad 'dus pa'i dbus su gsungs bsngo rgyas pa shis brjod dang bcas pa gnang zhing*/ ngam ring chos sde/ bzang ldan/ jo nang sogs byang khog gi dgon pa phal che ba dang*/ ngor gser mdog can sogs su mang ja bsngo rten grwa la 'gyed/ snyan dar dkar me/ 'phan sogs mchod rdzas dpag med 'bul ba sogs zhal bkod kyis khyab par mdzad nas jo nang du phebs/ mgon po lcam dral gyi 'chams/ sku 'khor rnams kyi zhal 'bag dang bcas pa bzhengs pa gnang*/ rab tu gnas pa gnang nas ye shes pa bzhugs nges pa'i zil can du gyur/ de skabs jo nang gi che bgres rnams kyis rje nyid kyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma gcig bzheng zer/ rgyu dar zab sman bzang drugarin po che'i phye ma sna tshogs pa bsres pa las grub pa/

nang gzhug sku gsung thugs kyi rten gzungs sngags/ ring bsrel sogs dpag tu med pas bkang ba 'di bzhengs nas/ rab tu gnas pa rgyas par gnang nas 'du khang du bzhugs su gsol/ rta lo sku mtshams dam par gnang yod pa'i skabs dbyar sos bsam 'grub rtse nas dpon sa bdag mo'i drung chos bros mdzad nas phebs/ de nas myur stabs su sde pa kun spangs drung sku mched kyang myur shangs su phebs/ dpon sa rin po che nas gtsug phud bzhes dgos tshul nan zhus byung na yang*/ sku mtshams stabs nas su la yang mjal kha ma gnang*/ 'on kyang bka' bkod gnang ba'i zhal ngo mthun grub kyi sgo nas dbu bsil gnang*/ sde pa sku mched kyis kyang 'bul ba rgya che ba mdzad nas phyir thegs/ lug lo rje dbon drung mnga' ris la rnam rgyal chos sde'i mkhan por rdzong ltar gnang*/ de nas spre'u lo lo gsar dbu legs nas kyi zhabs phyir chos lung sgrub sde ba nyi shu tsam gyis kyai rdo rje chos lung sgrub pa byin gyis bde mchog lha lnga/ jo nang cho ga shes pa rnams kyis dus 'khor jo nang lugs/ dgon pa bde chen pa rnams kyis dus 'khor bdag chen lugs/ brag ram pas kun rig /dkar po bas kyai rdor sgrub mchod byed mi rnams tshes drug la 'dzoms thig btab/ bdun pa sta gon tshes brgyad rgyal phur 'dzom pa la dngos gzhi ste/ dkyil 'khor yang dus 'khor ras bris dang*/ gzhan rnams rdul tshon las bzhengs/ rab tu gnas pa gnang bas/ ston pa dus 'khor/ kun mkhyen rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa rnams kyi skus me tog bzhes shing*/ nam mkhar 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim phub pa kun gyis mthong bas dad mos ngo mtshar dpag med du gyur/ rab gnas dga' ston yang tsā ru'i bza' ba rgya che dpangs mtho ba dang*/ de skabs gzhis rgyang byang gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i khri snar gting skyes sogs/ so so nas 'bul ba rgya che ba 'byung*/ de nas rig byed pa rnams la ja gos dar gtso bor gyur pa/

dpon slob so sor gang la gang 'tshams blo yul las 'das pa lta bu'i gnang sbyin gnang bas yid mgu ba bla na med pa thob cing*/ rje nyid kyis bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par gnang ste/ stag lung gtso bor gyur pa'i dad pa can rnams kyis phul ba'i dngos po rnams chud mi zos par song zhing thugs bde bar gyur/ de nas zla ba gnyis sku mtshams gnang ba grol mtshams/ gnas rnying nas rje gsang ba'i drung bka' chos gsan pa la ched gtad phebs pa la/ tshe dbang khrid bcas/ sgrol dkar gyi tshe khrid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skor rnams dang rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs kyi lung sogs bka' chos mang bar gnang*/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen gyi mkhan rin po che lung rig pa dpon slob rnams chos lung byang rtse'i rten mjal dang*/ rje nyid du bka' chos gsan pa la phebs byung ba nas/ jo nang du spyir bka' chos mang ba dang*/ khyad par ras chen dpal 'byor nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang gnang bas/ tshe mda' 'phel ba'i rten 'brel byung bas shin tu thugs dgyes par gyur/ rje nyid kyis kyang dus 'khor lugs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gsan nas/ mkhan chen pa dpon slob phyir thegs/ dgun khrid grol nas sku mtshams rgyang tsam gnang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gtso bor gnang nas ltas khyad par rnams brnyes/ de mtshams khri khang nas yum grongs song bas dgongs rdzogs la spyan 'dren byung ba nas/ chos lung dang jo nang gi sgrub sde drag bsdus dang bcas phebs/ snga dro mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ dgong mo rnal 'byor ma'i gsung chog mdzad pa'i sgo nas rjes su bzung*/ grol khar dge 'dun mang dag 'dus pa'i dbus su bsngo ba smon lam rgyas par gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ bya rgod gshongs kyi mkhan chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa/ khro phu gdan sa pa shag tshal 'bum ram pa sogs mang dag la ni gu'i khrid lung dang bcas pa dang*/

rjes gnang 'ga' shas gnang*/ byang pa bdag pos rma bya shug khrod kyi logs bris rab gnas la spyan 'dren zhus nas phebs/ rab gnas zhag gsum gnang*/ me tog gi char 'babs pa sogs ltas kyang legs par byung*/ der sa skyong chen po sku gzhon pa yid bzhin nor bu'i drung la tshe dbang lha dgu/ grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa sogs gnang nas ngam ring rtser phebs/ der yang bka' chos mang bar gnang nas/ rngod la brgyud gdong dgar phebs/ zhag 'ga' yar song dus nub gcig gzim chung gi lho nub mtshams su thog babs/ rje nyid kyi zhabs sus g.yas pa'i bzhugs gdan nas song bas/ nang so bstan pa legs sogs zhal ngo thams cad thugs 'tshabs pa'i ngang la phebs byung bas/ nged la ci yang gnod pa ma byung 'og tu gzigs gsungs/ gzigs pas mi gnyis la me lce gnod pa byung na yang phugs skyon ma byung*/ de'i sang mdang dgong grub pa'i rtags dngos su ston pa mdzad pa'i sku la nyes skyon med pa'i dga' ston yin gsungs/ karma gan kar gyis gtsos pa'i 'bul ba rlabs che ba byung*/ der tshe dbang dang mgon po'i bka' bsgos sogs gnang nas/ lha rtse brgyud jo nang du phebs/ de thams cad du ngam ring sde srid dpon blon/ gzhis ka zhabs drungs/ khri snar/ gting skyes sogs phyogs tha dad nas grub pa'i rtags mngon gyur du ston pa gnang ba'i dga' ston gyi 'bul ba rgya che ba dang*/ bstod bkur bsngags pa'i 'phreng ba phul lo/ /de nas dgun khrid 'dzug pa gnang*/ sngon 'gro'i skabs su dus 'khor chos 'byung sogs spyi bshad rgyas pa dang mchog dbang gi skabs las can 'ga' shas kyis rje nyid rdo rje shugs dngos su mthong ba yang byung*/ dngos gzhi'i skabs khrid zhu ba phal che ba la rtags snang ci rigs su shar zhing*/ chos lung du dus chen la phebs/ grol 'phral snar thang nas spyan 'dren byung ba bzhin/ dpon sa yum zhing brjes pa'i dgongs rdzogs su 'dug pas zla phyed tsam bzhugs nas mi 'khrugs pa'i gsung chog dang*/

mthar mtshan byang bzhu ba tshwa tshwa'i bar du grub nas/ snar thang tshogs su sa dge gnyis 'dus kyi dge 'dun tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ bcom ldan rigs ral gyi bzhugs khri'i steng nas bsngo ba shis brjod kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa gnang*/ yar lam chu mig gi rje btsun ma la phyag mchod gnang nas ri khrod chen mor phebs/ dbyar chos la smar khrid sbyor rtsa ma gnang*/ de nas dbon drung rin po che'i gdan 'dren dang bstun chos lung byang rtser phebs/ sgrub sde la ni gu'i khrid rgyas pa dang*/ smon gror zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs gnang skabs/ byang nas bdag po rin po che bkra shis stobs rgyal phebs/ bka' chos dgos gsungs nan skyed che ba nas dgongs bzhed dang bstun tshe 'dzin dkar po'i rjes gnang thog mar gnang nas/ de rjes tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ tshe khrid tshe dbang lha dgu mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs bka' chos mang dag gnang nas/ jo nang du phebs/ sgrub sde la snying po don gsum gyi khrid mi trā dzo ki'i rnam thar/ bu ston chos 'byung gi bshad lung sogs gnang*/ byang stag lung sogs dbus phyogs nas sngar nas spyan 'dren snyan zhus mang dag byung zhing*/ de skabs spyan 'dren nan che nas shar phyogs la chibs kha bsgyur nas/ snar thang bsam 'grub rtse khri khang sogs su bka' chos rim par gnang nas/ rong ral lngar zhabs drung sta ེ nga zhal mjal/ tshe dbang kyai rdor gyi dbang*/ dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid rjes gnang 'ga' yang gnang*/ ngur smrig tu sgrol ma gsungs 'byon la snyan dar zhal gser phyag mchod dang*/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i phyag rjes la phyag mchod smon lam gnang nas rong grags sar phebs/ tshe rta sbrags ma sogs gnang*/ rim gyis rong chen brgyud de dpal der phebs/ der yang bka' chos mang bar gnang*/ gam pa la la phebs nas chu bo ri'i shan la brgyud nas/

gdan 'dren dang bstun nas smyug la/ chu shul gye re/ 'tshar sa sna ljangs snye thang rnams su rim pas phebs/ gang la gang 'dod kyi chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher bstsal/ lam bar na yod pa'i gnyos sangs rgyas ras chen gyi sku lder phyag nas ma sogs gya ི re'i lha khang gi rten gsum rnams dang*/ snye thang 'khor gyi jo bo'i gnas rten rnams dang*/ chos rdzong gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bzhugs gnas rten gsum sogs thams cad la phyag mchod smon lam rgyas par gnang*/ de nas chos 'khor lha sar phebs/ jo bo rin po che sogs 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad kyi gtsos pa'i rten byin rlabs can rnams la zhal gser/ snyan dar dkar me phyag mchod rgyas pa dang*/ gser ston rgya che ba gnang*/ dpon sa chos skyong dbang mos spyan drangs/ yer pa lha ri snying por phebs/ gnas thams cad zhib mjal gnang zhing bka' chos shin tu 'phel/ de nas glang thang du phebs tshogs pa la mang ja dang chos 'brel gnang*/ shar ba 'bum pa dang*/ po to sogs mjal nas stag lung du phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te phebs/ rje rin po che rtse ba khu dbon dang mjal thog mar tshe dpag med dkar po'i rjes gnang*/ de nas tshe dpag med lha dgu brgya rtsa/ grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ tshe khrid rgyas pa/ sgrol dkar gyi khrid/ dmar po skor gsum/ ku ru kul+le'i gsang khrid ni gu'i khrid 'bring bo chos drug so so'i bka'/ ye shes mgon po'i bka' ni gu'i rnam thar dang khrid yig sogs po ti gnyis kyi lung*/ dzam dmar tshe ring mched lnga bo dong ba'i lugs kyi thugs dam lha lnga'i rjes gnang rnams dang*/ tshogs chen la bka' gdams glegs bam dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i rnam thar gyi lung dang*/ smra khrid rnams gnang*/ so so'i 'dod chos gang la gang 'tshams su gnang*/ stag lung pa dpon slob thams cad kyi zhabs tog 'bul ba mtha' yas pa mdzad/ byang rwa sgreng du phebs/

jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje la zhal gser snyan dar sogs mchod pa dang*/ gnas mjal zhib pa dang*/ de thams cad du smon lam rgyas par gnang nas lcang lung chos sding du phebs/ rten rnams la dkar me snyan dar sogs mchod pa dang*/ mkhan po dbu mdzad tshogs pa la chos 'brel mang ja 'gyed bcas gnang*/ chos 'khor rtser paṇa chen rdor rgyal pa'i nang rten la zhal gser snyan dar/ tshogs pa la mang ja zhu mi gnang nas lha sar phebs/ zhal gser snyan dar sogs 'bul ba rgyas pa gnang*/ yar rgyab nas sde pa dpon chen yang der phebs pa dang thugs mjal bar phebs byung zhing chos 'brel gnang*/ phyis yar rgyab la phebs dgos zhu ba byung yang phebs ma thub/ gung thang dang mtshal gyi rten mjal gnang nas/ shel gro lum pa sogs brgyud nas drang srong srin po ri'i rten mjal mdzad/ spyan 'dren byung ba bzhin gong dkar du phebs/ sras yum la bka' chos gnang*/ gam pa dang dpal de nas grags sar phebs/ tshe dbang lha dgu dang brgya rtsa sogs gnang*/ bdag gis rab tu byung ba'i bka' drin mnos/ 'jam dkar dang mi tra'i rjes gnang yang gnang*/ pho brang rin po che spungs par phebs/ zhabs drung steng zhal sras bcas su/ tshe dbang kyai rdo rje'i dbang*/ mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang nas bkra shis rdzong dkar phebs/ tshe dbang sogs gnang*/ gnyen yod gser mdog can gyi chos grwar chen por dge 'dun tshogs chen gyi ser sbrengs zab rgyas kyis spyan drangs/ bla brang chen por phebs/ mkhan chen zla ba bzang pos kyang phebs bsu sogs srid zhu dpag med mdzad/ der tshogs chen la mang ja 'gyed bcas/ bsngo rten gzabs ma/ dngul gdung rin po cher gos yug

/rje btsun byams pa la dar yug gi snyan dar/ sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu la zhal gser byams khang lam 'bras lha khang*/ mgon khang kun mkhyen don yod dpal 'byor sogs so sor snyan dar/ mar me mchod rdzas phul zhing*/ phyag mchod smon lam dpag med gnang*/ ka drug mar mkhan slob/ bka' bcur rab 'byams dpon chos mdzad/ rags bsdus la paṇa chen rin po che'i rnam thar/ khrid brgya dus 'khor bsdus rgyud sogs kyi lung dang tshe dbang*/ tshogs chos su 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang gnang nas pho brang bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ sde pa zhing gi bsnyen bkur zhabs tog zhus/ snar thang shel dkar sogs su 'dod chos gnang nas ri khrod chen mor phebs/ dbyar tshes la blo sbyong 'gro mgon dpal ye'i yig cha ltar gyi khrid dang*/ rgyab chos su legs bshad kun 'dus sogs kyi lung gnang nas/ mtshan ltas 'tshub tsam byung nas tshe sgrub kyi sku mtshams shin tu dam pa gnang*/ zla ba gcig lhag tsam song ba'i tho rangs kha cig gi mnal lam na/ glo bo'i rma bya shug khrod kyi lung pa kun me tog gser gtso ma'i mdog can gyis khengs par byung bas/ de tshe sgrub kyi ltas su legs par bshad 'dug pas tshe mthar phyin yod pa yin nam gsungs ba byung*/ de nas smon gror phebs/ zla ba gnyis tsam bzhugs nas chos lung du phebs/ dngul gdung rin po cher snyan dar mchod 'bul gnang*/ rje drung rdo ring pa dang mjal thugs snang dag pa'i sgo nas bla ma gong ma'i lo rgyus sogs gsungs gleng zhib par gnang*/ rje rdo ring par bka' 'bum 'dod 'jo'i lung phul zhing*/ tshur kun spangs rin po che'i rnam thar dang*/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang gsan/ slar jo nang du phebs blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum gyi lung dang bcas pa gnang*/ de nas jo nang skyid phug tu zla ba gnyis lhag tsam sku mtshams gnang*/ tho rangs shig gi mnal lam du rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang mjal/
