phyag dbu thog tu bzhag nas lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gnang nas/ tshe rabs kun du 'bral ba med gsungs pa'i snang ba byung bas/ mnal sad nas thugs dgyes pa chen po 'khrungs/ sngar ltar dus khrid gnang ba grol/ rje nyid dgung lo re drug tu phebs pa sa pho stag lo shar/ de lo rje btsun rin po che dag pa'i zhing du phebs nas lo skor gcig tsam song ba'i dus mchod chen mo yin pa nas/ dbon drung rin po ches gdan 'dren gnang ba bzhin chos lung byang rtser phebs/ dus chen steng du rje nyid kyis kyai rdo rje/ rje rdo ring pa dpon slob gyis bde mchog nag po pa/ bstan 'dzin rin po che dpon slob kyis bde mchog nag po pa/ rin po che brag stod pa dpon slob kyis rnal 'byor ma/ pha dre bo dpon slob kyis phag mo/ dgon pa dkar po pa rnams kyis kyai rdo rje/ chos lung sgrub sde byin gyis bde mchog lha lnga dang rnal 'byor ma/ rma bya shug khrod sgrub sde ba rnams kyis rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga gnang ste/ so sos rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams nas sgrub mchod dang mchod 'bul rgyas par mdzad/ de skabs rje nyid kyi phyag nas dngul gdung rin po che la gos dar yug ring ga ི sa gtso ba'i na bza'/ mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ bla ma che chung thams cad la 'bul ba/ tshogs pa rnams gral 'gyed bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa gnang*/ de bzhin du bla chen gzhan rnams kyis kyang mchod rdzas bsnyen bkur 'gyed bcas dang*/ der ma phebs pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i dngos slob phyogs na bzhugs pa'i che phra mang dag dang*/ sbyin bdag tu gtogs pa'i sde dpon thams cad kyis/ dngul gdung rin po cher gos dar yug gi gtsos pa'i snyan dar/ mchod rdzas/ bla ma so so la 'bul ba tshogs pa la bsnyen bkur dpag med 'dug cing*/

khyad par smon 'gro nas zhabs tog /rkang len rgya cher mdzad/ de dag gi skabs su nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi gur khyim/ me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ltas ya mtshan pa mang du byung*/ rje nyid kyis pha dre bo'i sku skyes gtsos pa'i drag bsdus la kyai rdo rje'i dbang*/ byin rlabs khog phub kyi bka' gnyis kyis sgo phye ste ni gu'i khrid rgyas pa chos drug so so'i bka' dang bcas pa/ phyag drug pa dkar nag gnyis rjes gnang*/ ni gu'i brgyud pa'i rnam thar dang yig rnying mang po'i lung*/ rje btsun rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung sogs dang*/ dre bo sku skye sku rkyang la tshe dbang grub rgyal ma brgya rtsa/ lha dgu'i dbang*/ nag po gzhung drug rnams gnang*/ bla ma gzhan rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi blo 'dod dang mthun pa'i chos bshad gnang*/ de ltar dus mchod rgyas pa gnang ba grol nas/ gting skyes nas rab 'byams pa bstan pas gtsos pa'i spyan 'dren nan can rang byung ba ltar/ jo nang*/ gdong dga'/ rma bya/ dpal rtse/ byams gling sogs brgyud nas lam du yod pa'i sde dpon/ bla ma slob dpon rnams gang 'tshams kyi bka' chos gnang nas/ gting skyes sde srid kyis gtsos pa'i phebs bsu/ ser sbrengs rgyas pa dang bcas mkhar chen rtser phebs/ sde srid bcas la thog mar sgrol dkar khrus chog dang bcas pa/ tshe dbang grub rgyal lha dgu/ rnam 'joms/ sme brtsegs/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ sngon po/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ dmar ser/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs/ rnam sras/ mgon ser sogs dbang rjes gnang khrus chog mang bar gnang*/ der drung rdo ring pa yang phebs/ rgyang tsam bzhugs pa gnang*/ rje nyid kyis mkhan po/ rje drung rdo ring pas las slob gnang ste bsgrub bya bzhi bcu tsam la bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ de nas mdo khar mchod yon gnyis kas phebs/ zhag shas song mtshams chu spe gsar 'debs shig byed dgos 'dug pas/

gang du chu brus na legs/ bslab ston dgos zhu pa la/ de nas dpon slob rang thugs nyams che bas nged kyis tshul 'bul mi dgos pa phebs pas/ byin rlabs kyang yod zhing*/ sang gza' skar bzang bas zhabs 'chag tsam gnang dgos zhus nas sang nyin phebs/ sde pa dpon blon rnams kyis dmigs gtad kyi sar rje nyid kyis gsungs bkod ma gnang bar rlan cher med pa'i sa khad mtho snyoms pa zhig tu phyag mkhar 'dzugs pa gnang nas 'dir dgyes pa 'dug /nang so chos rab sogs byings rnams cung zad the tshom du gyur kyang*/ sde pa rang dad mos che bas bka' phebs 'di kar brus gsungs zhag mang por brus kyang rlan tshad ye ma byung bas/ chu thon mi thon thugs dam brtag pa zhig gnang dgos zhu bar/ rje'i gsungs las/ brtag pa ni mi dgos par mchis/ sang nyin gzhi bdag gtor ma zhig byed gsungs ba byung*/ de nas zhag gnyis nas pha bong zur can zhig 'dug pa de thon/ dkon mchog gis mi bslu gsungs/ pha bong thon 'phral rdzong ngos nas chu bzang po thon/ de dam pa rnams kyis chu phud 'bul du byung skabs/ sde pa dpon g.yog thams cad thugs shin tu dgyes/ sku gzhogs su 'bul ba mang du mdzad/ de nas tshur phebs pa'i bka' bkod gnang bas/ chu spe mthar thon gyi bar bzhugs pa'i phyag nas gnang dgos zhes nan zhus che ba nas chu spe mkhar las grub kyi bar bzhugs/ de skabs nang so mgon tshe bas rtse chen du phyin pa'i skad cha la/ rje btsun tham cad mkhyen pa'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rje tā ra nā tha'o dbus phyogs su sku bltams pa'i gtam snyan/ sna dkar rtse nas rgyal rtse brgyud pa'i skad cha dang*/ de mtshungs smon gro nas kyang gtam snyan 'bul ba dang spyan 'dren pa byung*/ chu spe yang mthar thon gyis phyag nas mdzad/ lce lung nas spyan 'dren byung*/ der dgongs pa ltar gyi bka' chos thog ma gnang*/ rim pas brgyud ri khrod jo nang du phebs/

de nas sprul sku rin po che spyan 'dren la rje nyid phebs te/ de dang chab gcig par rje drung rdo ring pa/ rin po che brag stod pa/ dbon drung 'phan/ ngam ring nas mi sna drag sbrel dang bcas nas dpal 'khor chos sder phebs/ der mjal kha zhus/ shin tu thugs dgyes pa chen po dang ldan par gyur/ rgyal rtse nas mchod yon gyis gzhi len rgyas par zhus/ mkhan chen po la thugs 'dod kyi chos gnang*/ rtse chen khri khang bsam 'grub rtse/ snar thang brgyud ri khrod chen mo jo mo nang du phebs bsu rgyas pa dang bcas spyan drangs/ zhabs tog rgyas par zhu ba gnang zhing 'ga' shas bzhugs/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i zhabs drung du bkra shis kha btags gser srang gang*/ hor dkar chag med/ gos ber/ chib bzang ba sogs nyi shu rtsa lnga tshan dang*/ rje rdo ring pa/ rje brag stod pa sogs so sor yang 'bul gnang mdzad do/ /dregs ldan sa skyong 'bum gyi ral pa yis/ /yongs su phyes pa zhabs sen nyi ma'i 'od/ /'bar yang zhu dul zla 'od mi 'gog pa/ /phul du byung ba'i khyad chos yongs su gzung*/ /rdo rje'i brag yang 'gog nus gnam lcags lces/ / sku la brdzi bar ma nus mtshar ci zhig /rdul snyed bdud sdes 'phangs pa'i mtshon cha'i tshogs/ /zas gtsang sras la me tog char du gyur/ /thugs rje'i nyi 'od dang 'grogs dam chos kyis/ /bdud rtsi zil char dal bur babs pa na/ /skal ldan rnams la ye shes lnga'i rang gzugs/ /'ja' 'od gsal ba'i rtags bcu mngon du gyur/ /skad cig gcig la gling bzhi ther 'bum snyed/ /myur zhing sdang bar sems pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bsregs las dus mtha'i me bas ches dpa' ba'i/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis 'phrin las bsgrub/ /skyon med bsam gtan gyis bsgrubs lha mig gis/ /gzhal tshe ji snyed dngos po'i rang gzugs rnams/ /gsal bas shin tu rtogs ka'i sa phyogs su'ang*/ /dal 'gro'i gter chen yod pa dgongs te bstan/

/thugs rje'i stobs can gang gis skam po'i sar/ /chu rgyun phyur la ngo mtshar ci zhig yod/ /'di yi zad par chu yi ting 'dzin gyis/ /stong gsum chu yis 'gengs la dka' ba med/ /the'u rang bsgrubs dang mig mthong rdzas 'phrul la/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul du re'i chen po 'ga'/ / mthong gin grub pa'i rtags mtshan mngon gyur pa/ /nyer ston rje btsun khyod la snying nas dad/ /de nas rje btsun bla ma thams cad mkhyen/ dag pa'i zhing nas slar yang zla ba bzhin/ /sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i snang brnyan shar ba la/ /gus dang mchod pa'i rgyun gyis spyan 'dren mdzad/ /de nas sprul sku rin po che dpon slob kyang smon gro brgyud chos lung byang rtser phebs/ rje nyid kyis sku mtshams zla ba gnyis tsam gnang ba grol nas dgun khrid gnang*/ de nas chos lung byang rtser phebs/ gza' skar dge ba la rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku la thog mar tshe dbang phul/ de nas dbang lung rjes gnang mang bar 'bul ba gnang nas smon gror phebs dus dbang rnams gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ bde mchog nag po'i gsungs bsnyen zla ba bdun gnang*/ legs par grub nas kha gso'i sbyin sreg gnang skabs nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang*/ me tog gi char babs/ ltas ya mtshan pa byung*/ bka' bkod la 'di'i bsnyen pa byed pa 'phyis 'dug yang yang bka' phebs pa zhig byung*/ de mtshams khri khang nas sde pa don grub la gshegs nas spyan 'dren nan can byung bas/ pa snam lhun grub rtser phebs/ dgung zhag gi bar la mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i gsung chog mdzad/ mtshan byang bzhu ba grub rjes/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ sgrol dkar/ mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ ma cig bka' po ma'i khrid lung dang bcas pa gnang*/ de nas rgyu dang bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshogs khro che ba gsang blugs gnang*/ shis brjod mdzad nas zhal dro'i tshul du mang ja 'bras 'jam sogs gnang*/

de nas sku mtshams rgyang tsam gnas skabs tho rangs shigabud med gzhon nu'i rnam pa g.yu'i thor tshugs dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa/ dar gyi gos lhab lhub tu gyon pa/ lag na me long dang mda' dar 'dzin pa 'khor dang bcas pa zhig byung nas/ snyan pa'i glu len zhing rin po che'i snod bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas/ nged la chos kyi sbrang rtsi'i zim char spel ba'i legs lam yin zer byung ba'i ngang la mnal sad/ de nas kyang sgra de snyan lam na lhang nge 'dug gsungs/ de nas dus kyi dgun khrid la phyogs kyi bla ma slob dpon/ cha lung sgrub chen ma sogs chos don gnyer ba phyogs nas kyang mang du byung ba la sbyor drug rgyas pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ kun spangs chen po'i khrid yigachos rje phyogs rgyal pa'i sngon 'gro thog mtha' bar dge /ngo sprod gsang don rab gsal gyi khrid lung gnang*/ de nas khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sbrul lo'i dus chen la rje drung rdo ring pa gting skyes nas phebs longs ma byung bar/ rje nyid la spyan 'dren byung bas chos lung du phebs/ bde mchog nag po pa'i sgrub mchod gtso bo gnang*/ grub sde la bsnyen bkur gzabs ma bstsal/ de skabs sde pa bka' bzhi nas tshul khrims 'gyur med phebs/ thugs 'dod bzhin gzhung bka' nyer lnga dang 'brel ba'i ni gu'i khrid rgyas pa lung dang bcas pa gzhan yang tshe dbang rnam grangs mang ba sogs gnang*/ slar jo nang du phebs/ de lo'i dbyar chos la grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i byin rlabs lung dang bcas pa gnang*/ de nas de lo rmi ltas 'tshub pas mtshams dam par byed gsungs bcad rgya dam par mdzad/ rgyang tsam song nas smon gror dpon drung rin po che sku khams bsnyel bas/ 'phral du chos rje lha mchog pa phebs pa la/ sa skya bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi lung*/ tshe dbang tshe khrid sogs bka' chos mang du gnang*/ de nas gting skyes nas sa skyong ngag dbang rnam rgyal yab sras kyis spyan drangs/

mkhar chen du phebs/ sde pa yab sras rnams la tshe dbang lha dgu/ grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa tshe khrid/ gzhan yang sgrol ma dkar sngo/ 'jam dbyangs dkar ser mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs dang*/ byings rnams la yang 'dod chos dpag med stsal nas tshur phebs te/ byams gling dpal rtse/ gdong dga' rnams su rim pas phebs shing so so'i 'dod chos rnams gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ der rje dbon rin po che yang glo bo nas phebs te/ rje dbon dang*/ tsha rong grags pa blo gros sogs drag bsdus la shangs chos rgyas par gnang ste/ rtsa ba ni gu'i chos drugasdong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga lam 'khyer rnam gsum/ me tog mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'chi med 'chug med rnams kyi khrid dang lung*/ gzhung bka' nyer lnga dang 'brel bar gnang*/ der bdag gis kyang mjal bar slebs te/ mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs thob/ smon gror phebs pa'i phyag phyir bdag kyang dkris pa'i tshe dbang sogs gnang*/ slar bdag gis kyang ngam ring gi grwa skor 'khor nas smon gro dang jo nang sogs su tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ tshe khrid tshe dpag med lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang sogs dbang lung khrid mang bar thob cing*/ thugs rje chen pos brtse bar bskyang*/ yang skabs shig jo nang dbyar chos la dus 'khor snyan brgyud kyi khrid gnang zhing*/ lo phu gdan sa ba sogs la yang khrid brgya mang bar gnang*/ de nas lha rtser spyan drangs nas byang pa bdag po nam mkha' rgyal po steng zhal la/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang dang*/ grub rgyal ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa khrid bcas gnang*/ slar jo nang du dus tshigs kyi dgun khrid/ bya gshongs mkhan chen pa sogs la gsung chos mang bar gnang*/ dgun khrid grol nas chos lung du dus chen la phebs/ rje btsun mchog gi sprul sku mjal/ tshe dbang lha dgu sogs 'bul ba gnang*/ rje rdo ring rin po che dang bka' chos 'bul res

gnang*/ dgun khrid grol nas chos lung*/ smon gror bka' chos thogs ma gnang nas jo nang du phebs/ sa skya gong ma rdo rje 'chang mus chen rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bdud rtsi'i ril bu ma lta gnang nas/ yi dam kyai rdo rje la brten nas bdud rtsi ril bu phyag len bzhin du bsgrub pa gnang nas/ lde gu'i skabs nas dri bzang rgyang ring por tshor ba dang*/ ril bu 'phel shin tu che ba byung nas/ byang stag lung ngam ring*/ gting skyes sogs gnang 'os rnams su gnang*/ de nas nged rang khams bzang skabs jo nang gi gdan sa 'di mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'bul thub pa zhig ci nas kyang byed gsungs/ ngam ring steng zhal du zhu ba gnang bas khrol dka' ba byung na yang*/ 'bul chas gang drag dang bcas nan skyed zhu ba gnang bas khrol nas phebs bsu gzabs ma dang bcas gdan drangs/ bzang skar dge ba la khri thog tu phebs/ shis brjod kyi me tog 'bul ba dang mnyam du sku gsung thugs kyi rtain/ dbang rdzas rol mo'i rigs/ ja gos dar/ gser dngul/ byu ru spos shel ras cha sogs sku chas gang yod sprug pa'i 'bul ba rgya cher gnang*/ der zhag nyi shu skor bzhugs par zhabs tog gang zab dang*/ bka' chos sbyor drug gi khrid/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ 'grel chen dri med 'od kyi lung*/ ni gu'i mgyogs khrid sogs 'bul pa gnang*/ de nas rje dbon drung mnga' ris la rdzongs ltar mdzad do/ / chos dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin mang du gnang ngo*/ /zung 'jug sgom pa'i gom stabs gcig nyid kyis/ /bcu gsum sa yi them skas nges bgrod nas/ /bde chen 'khor lo sdom pa rgyal srid la/ /dbang bsgyur de tshe sgrib pa'i stobs ldan bcom/ /gang la sa gsum mkha' 'gros ga ma ka'i/ /dbyangs dang lhan cig bdud rtsis mchod par byas/ /dad pa'i blo can yid skyes rnam mang gis/ /gzhal bar dka' ba'i zang zing dngos pos kyang*/

/ gang dang 'brel bas srid mthar bde ba'i rgyun/ /skyed byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa ches 'phyur ba/ /mdun du rgyu yang don gnyer med pa yi/ /skye bo 'ga' dang 'ga' yang byung bar gyur/ /rnam par rtog pa med bzhin res bral la/ /gang 'dod bsam par mthun pa'i mchod sbyin che/ /spro ba dpag bsam shing dang mtshungs bsam yang*/ /de ni sems med khyed thugs rnam kun mkhyen/ /yon tan gyis lci bla ma'i zhabs pad zungs/ /'degs la khyab 'jug stobs kyang pham bgyid pas/ /nor bzang sems dpa' che dang nā ro pa'i/ /bla mar mos pa dag kyang zil gyis mnan/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis snying myos pa'i/ /grub pa'i gar gyis zhing 'di bkang ba na/ /grub dbang gzhan gyis go skabs thob min zhes/ /dag pa'i zhing khams gzhan du bzhud pa bzhin/ /rin chen du ma las grub mtshan dpe'i gzugs/ /de la gang thugs ye shes rjes zhugs pas/ /de dang mtshungs par rgyal ba'i ye shes kun/ /'dus pa lha mi'i mchod gnas mchog tu gyur/ /lha ldan gtsug lag khang na zas gtsang sras/ / rjes mtshon sku de 'gran zla med snyam pa'i/ khengs pa gzhil phyir byon pa yin no zhes/ /cung zad 'dzum pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa snyam/ /de nas myos byed ces pa shing mo lug gi lo rje nyid dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum bzhes pa'i hor zla gnyis pa'i nang du sku grib la brten pa'i cung zad sku khams bsnyel ba byung yang*/ sku rims dang lha rje gsol sman gyi 'phrod bsten phul bas zhag shas nas sku khams bde bar gyur/ de nas nyin gcig nyi ma phyed yol tsam la/ khar sang nas khyed rnams kyis rje rdo ring pa zhing brjes pa nged la gsang 'dug pas/ da lta rang 'dir sgrub sde la mang ja/ sku 'bum lha khang so sor dkar me snyan dar phul/ chos lung byang rtser dngul gdung rin po cher mchod rdzas na bza'/ mang ja sogs thongs gsungs nas/ phyag g.yog rnams kyis de rnams 'phral du bsgrubs/

der bla ma mchod pa rgyas pa re mdzad mtshams/ nged rgan po rnams dus gcig la 'gro ran gsungs pa byung nas/ yang sku khams mi bde ba'i tshul ston pa gnang*/ hor zla gsum pa'i nyer bdun gyi snga dro/ da nangs tho rangs su rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku'i snang ba byung gsungs/ de nas thugs dam gyi rim pa rnams mdzad rjes mthar ni gu'i 'pho ba gnang ste/ gzim chung 'gag na yod pa rnams kyis thag ces pa'i sgra byung ma thag nang du phyin dus/ zhal ras zil pa khrom me ba dang dbu gtsug 'phar zhing rlangs 'tshub yod pa mthong zhing*/ mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de ma thag nam mkha' g.ya' dgame tog gi char babs/ rol mo'i sgra dbyangs grags pa phal cher bas tshor/ der chos lung sgrub sde'i drag pa rnams dang*/ jo nang nyid kyi grub sde'i drag pa rnams kyis sku gdung sku gzhogs su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod byas shing*/ rje btsun mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bsam sdings su bzhugs pa myur shad du spyan 'dren btang nas spyan 'drongs/ chos lung*/ jo nang*/ ngor pa/ bde chen pa/ brag ram pa sogs chos sde mang po phebs te/ dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phyes nas zhag mang po'i bar du sgrub mchod rgyas par mdzad/ de mthun gser mdog can sogs dbus gtsang gi chos grwa dang*/ thub bstan dar rgyas gling sogs mnga' ris smad kyi chos grwa rnams su mang ja 'gyed bcas rgya cher bsgrubs/ dgongs rdzogs dngos gzhi'i nyin sku chas drag kha gang yod rje btsun rin po cher phul/ gzhan bla ma slob dpon dge 'dun gyi sde der tshogs thams cad la 'bul ba'i dngos po bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul te/ thugs kyi dgongs pa yongs su bskongs par mdzad do//༈ 'gro blo'i re ba yongs su skong la dpag bsam shing yang ming gi zol/ /yid kyi gdung ba 'phrog par byed la lho phyogs me yang zil gyis mnan/ /kun la mkhyen brtse'i bsil zer 'gyed la 'od dkar can la tha mi dad/

/de phyir mdzad pa'i cha shas 'ga' la'ang dpe dang 'gran zlas dbul bar gyur/ /snying rje'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin zla ba de/ /'dzam gling gdul bya'i ku mud bzhad mdzad nas/ /lho gling mdzad pa'i chu mthong rdzogs so zhes/ /nub phyogs bde ba can der gshegs par rtsom/ /de tshe de yi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i 'ja' tshon gdugs mdzes dang*/ /me tog char dang pi waṃ sogs thogs nas/ /spyan 'dren slad du zhing 'dir lhags par gyur/ /'gyur med rdo rje'i dngos kyang 'ga' zhig gis/ /rtag par 'dzin pa'i blo mun 'joms so zhes/ /rab zhi'i nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi byin la/ /mchog tu bzhugs pa'i ting 'dzin mngon du mdzad/ /de tshe zhing 'di'i skye dgu lhar bcas la/ /mya ngan me lces snying gi dngos bsregs shing*/ /mchod pa'i dud sprin 'ja' tshon sna lnga ru/ /'thul bas phyogs kyi yangs pa 'gengs par byas/ /chos dbyings gdod ma'i nam mkha' rnyog bral la/ /sprul pa'i zla tshes 'gog pa med 'char bas/ /bdag cag gdul bya'i blo mtshor brnyan pa'i gzugs/ /cir yang rtsol zhes gsol gdab dbyangs su tsher/ /'ga' zhig bla ma dam pa grub pa'i dbang*/ /'di la gshegs dang bzhud pa mi mnga' yang*/ /rang cag blo yi me long rnyog pa la/ /'di ltar snang 'di byis pa'i blo zhes smra/ /de nas smon gro nas zhal ngo rnams kyis gdung rten gser zangs las grub pa thog so tsam gyi tshad longs ba/ bal po bzo bo mkhas pas bzhengs te/ gzungs rdzogs phun sum tshogs pa phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa mang pos rab tu gnas pa bgyis te/ 'du khang chen mor mchod pa'i yul dang tshogs gsog pa'i rten du bzhugs so/ /de ltar na rje btsun bla ma mchog 'di gzhon nu nas rab tu byung*/ thos bsam mdzad/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa'i thugs sras kyi gtso bor gyur/ de brjod 'dod tsam yin min ni/ rje gong ma'i rnam thar rnams la bltas pas shes par nus/

gtso bor sgom pa la thugs gzhol dngos po la 'dzin pa mi mnga'/ tshul khrims yongs su dag gnod byed la bzod pa tsam du ma bzhag gnod lan phan pas 'jal ba sogs pha rol du phyin pa drug la spyod pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che sku nyams su bstar/ nges don zab mo'i chos 'khor gtso bor bskor/ rgyu mtshan des na sgrub sde jo nang yang 'phel rgyas shin du che zhing*/ sgrub pa mo gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub chen thugs dam gyi rtsal 'byongs pa/ nyams rtogs phul du byung ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ nges don gyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar mdzad pa 'di ni lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phrin las su gyur zha ི nga*/ rnam par thar pa'i snying po'o/ /rigs brgya'i gtsun rgyan 'jam mgon kun dga'i mtshan 'chang gi / byin rlabs rin chen sna lnga'i srad bu mdangs gsal ba/ /gang thugs shel gyi dpal be'ur bzhugs pa'i mod nyid la/ /ye shes kha dog sna lngar 'bar ba'i gtam bzang po/ /bsgrags pa'i dge bas bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar/ khyab bdag bla ma gang des rjes bzung nas/ /'bral ba med par chos la spyod par shog /tshul khrims dag pa'i nye ba 'khor dang ni/ /byang chen spyod la kun tu bzang po dang*/ /rgyal ba'i chos tshul rdo rje theg pa'i don/ /'dzin la gsang ba'i bdag po dang mtshungs shog /klu sgrub yab sras bzhed pa'i lta ba dang*/ /thogs med mched pa'i rgya chen spyod pa'i srol/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug bzhed pa'i rim gnyis kyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas par byed nus shog /tshul khrims dag pa'i gzhi la legs gnas shing*/ /sde snod rgyud sde'i tshig don shes pa dang*/ /de don rgyud la 'byor ba'i nyams len gyis/ /dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub la brtson par shog /de nas lam lnga sa bcu ma lus pa/ /mos pa'i goms stabs gcig gis bgrod byas nas/
